minor.en: After the discovery of the &1Spirit Furnace&0 I was still determined to revive those spirits. To solve the problem of unstable mobs I put them inside &1Eggs&0, as an attempt to stabilize them. This process still requires some substantial amount of &4Blood&0 and of course an empty &1Egg&0.
minor.tw: 儘管發明瞭&1靈魂爐&0，我仍致力於完全復活靈魂。為解決靈魂不穩定的問題，我嘗試將其收容進&1雞蛋&0中以維持形態。該過程仍需消耗大量&4血液&0，當然還需要一個&1雞蛋&0作為容器。
minor.reason: 「發明瞭」為 OpenCC 轉換錯字
minor.fix: 儘管發明了&1靈魂爐&0，我仍致力於完全復活靈魂。為解決靈魂不穩定的問題，我嘗試將其收容進&1雞蛋&0中以維持形態。該過程仍需消耗大量&4血液&0，當然還需要一個&1雞蛋&0作為容器。

minor.en: Because of this more advanced process, spirits will be completely used up, so only one &1Egg&0 can be created per &1spirit&0.
minor.tw: 由於採用更先進的工藝，靈魂會被完全消耗，因此每個&1靈魂&0僅能生成一枚&1生怪蛋&0。
minor.reason: Egg 在鄰近條目譯為「雞蛋」，此條卻成「生怪蛋」
minor.fix: 由於採用更先進的工藝，靈魂會被完全消耗，因此每個&1靈魂&0僅能生成一個&1雞蛋&0。

minor.en: This will be useful until I find some less manual ways to get my hands on some &4Blood&0.
minor.tw: 在找到更省事的&4血液&0獲取方式之前，這西還算有用。
minor.reason: 「這西」漏字
minor.fix: 在找到更省事的&4血液&0獲取方式之前，這東西還算有用。

minor.en: After repairing items, I was sure I could take things to the next level. Items that can accept &4Blood&0, like the &1Dark Tanks&0 I introduced before, will be filled with &4Blood&0 when placed in this machine. Other specific items seem to transform in a special way when filled with &4Blood&0, here is a non-exhaustive list of items which can be infused. Giving this machine a redstone signal will pause any running process.
minor.tw: 嘗試過修復物品之後，我確信能將研究推向更高層次。將那些可容納&4血液&0的物品（如先前介紹的&1暗黑流體罐&0）置於此裝置中時，將被自動注入&4血液&0。其他特定物品在注入&4血液&0後，似乎會產生特殊的形態轉變，以下列舉部分可注入&4血液&0的物品。向該機器輸入紅石訊號可暫停目前所有程式。
minor.reason: process 譯為「程式」不當，應為程序
minor.fix: 嘗試過修復物品之後，我確信能將研究推向更高層次。將那些可容納&4血液&0的物品（如先前介紹的&1暗黑流體罐&0）置於此裝置中時，將被自動注入&4血液&0。其他特定物品在注入&4血液&0後，似乎會產生特殊的形態轉變，以下列舉部分可注入&4血液&0的物品。向該機器輸入紅石訊號可暫停目前所有程序。

minor.en: All possible &1Broom&0 parts must be created using the &1Bare Rod&0, &1Brush&0 and &1Cap&0, this can be done by combining these three parts of any material in any crafting grid. Parts made from different materials seem to have different properties. All possible properties will be explained in the following section, after that I will give an overview of all &1Broom&0 parts.
minor.tw: 所有&1掃帚&0部件必須以&1裸杆，裸刷&0和&1裸端&0為基礎製作，只需在任何合成方格中將這三種部件與材料組合即可。不同材料製成的部件擁有不同的屬性。後續小節中，我將詳細說明所有可獲得的屬性與&1掃帚&0部件類型。
minor.reason: 部件名以逗號連接且色碼 &1…&0 數量與原文不一致
minor.fix: 所有&1掃帚&0部件必須以&1裸杆&0、&1裸刷&0和&1裸端&0為基礎製作，只需在任何合成方格中將這三種部件與材料組合即可。不同材料製成的部件擁有不同的屬性。後續小節中，我將詳細說明所有可獲得的屬性與&1掃帚&0部件類型。

minor.en: When flying with the &1Broom&0, make sure that it has enough &4Blood&0 at all times, otherwise the &1Broom&0 will slow down significantly.
minor.tw: 駕馭&1掃帚&0飛行時，請其&4血液&0儲備始終充足，否則&1掃帚&0飛行速度將顯著下降。
minor.reason: 「請其」缺「確保」，語句不通
minor.fix: 駕馭&1掃帚&0飛行時，請確保其&4血液&0儲備始終充足，否則&1掃帚&0飛行速度將顯著下降。

minor.en: &l&nKamikaze&r&NWhen colliding with an entity the &1Broom&0 will explode. It is very unlikely that a mounted player would survive something like this.
minor.tw: &l&n神風&r&N與實體碰撞時，&1掃帚&0會爆炸。其上騎乘的玩家絕無倖存可能。
minor.reason: 原文為「極不可能倖存」，譯成「絕無倖存可能」
minor.fix: &l&n神風&r&N與實體碰撞時，&1掃帚&0會爆炸。騎乘其上的玩家極不可能倖存。

minor.en: &l&nSmash&r&NThis is used to enable the &1Broom&0 to break blocks when flying. Higher values can break harder blocks.
minor.tw: &l&n粉碎&r&N使&1掃帚&0飛行時能破壞方塊。數值越高，更高的值，可破壞硬度更大的方塊。
minor.reason: 「數值越高，更高的值，」疊加贅語
minor.fix: &l&n粉碎&r&N使&1掃帚&0飛行時能破壞方塊。數值越高，可破壞硬度越大的方塊。

minor.en: Holding right-click with this mace will build up a circular sphere around it that, when released, will trigger a force upon all other entities within that sphere knocking them back and causing some damage as long as the mace has enough &4Blood&0. Shift + right-clicking it will cycle through the different power levels, each higher level will cause more damage, but at the same time costs more &4Blood&0.
minor.tw: 手持該物品長按右鍵，可凝聚環繞周身的球形力場，鬆開右鍵時，將向力場範圍內所有實體釋放衝擊，造成擊退效果與一定傷害（前提是扭曲重錘有足夠的&4血液&0）。Shift右擊可迴圈切換不同強度等級，等級越高傷害越高，但消耗的&4血液&0也越多。
minor.reason: 「迴圈」為「循環」的轉換錯誤
minor.fix: 手持該物品長按右鍵，可凝聚環繞周身的球形力場，鬆開右鍵時，將向力場範圍內所有實體釋放衝擊，造成擊退效果與一定傷害（前提是扭曲重錘有足夠的&4血液&0）。Shift右擊可循環切換不同強度等級，等級越高傷害越高，但消耗的&4血液&0也越多。

minor.en: Transforms the target area into the contained biome. Crafted in Environmental Accumulator at desired biome.
minor.tw: 將目標區域的群系轉換為所含生態域。在對應生態域中的環境蓄積器中製作。
minor.reason: 「群系」為大陸用語，應統一用生態域
minor.fix: 將目標區域轉換為所含的生態域。在目標生態域中的環境蓄積器內製作。

minor.en: Hold in inventory when slaying mobs.\nShift + Right click to extract or auto-supply.
minor.tw: 放在物品欄，殺死生物時會收集血液。\nShift右擊以切換自動補給。
minor.reason: 漏譯「提取」功能，只剩切換自動補給
minor.fix: 放在物品欄，殺死生物時會收集血液。\nShift右擊以提取或切換自動補給。

minor.en: Throw a Dark Gem in the middle of a pool with at least five non-hardened Blood blocks. Or infuse a Dark Gem with blood.
minor.tw: 將暗黑寶石丟入至少存在5格血液的流體池中。或在血能注入器中用血液灌注暗黑寶石。
minor.reason: 漏「未硬化」「中央」，並多出原文沒有的血能注入器
minor.fix: 將暗黑寶石丟入至少有五格未硬化血液的血池中央。或用血液灌注暗黑寶石。

minor.en:
This action copies a file or folder in the game directory, which starts at the root of the Minecraft instance directory. This action is limited to work only inside the game directory for safety reasons.

It is also possible to access the default '.minecraft' directory with this action. For that, just start paths with the '.minecraft/' prefix.

Append '*' to the end of the source path to copy every file directly inside that folder. This wildcard ignores sub-directories and requires the destination to be a directory.
minor.tw:
這個動作會在遊戲目錄中複製一個檔案或資料夾，遊戲目錄從 Minecraft 例項目錄的根目錄開始。出於安全原因，這個動作只能在遊戲目錄內部使用。

這個動作也可以訪問預設的 ".minecraft" 目錄。只要把路徑以 ".minecraft/" 字首開頭就行。

在源路徑末尾追加 '*'，可以複製該資料夾內直接包含的所有檔案。這個萬用字元會忽略子目錄，並要求目標位置必須是一個目錄。

minor.reason: 字首、格式程式碼、聯絡伺服器、列印等用語不自然

minor.en:
This action downloads a file from a URL and saves it to the game directory, which starts at the root of the Minecraft instance directory. This action is limited to work only inside the game directory for safety reasons.

Provide the download folder instead of a file name; FancyMenu derives the saved file name from the HTTP response headers or the URL automatically.

§lAsynchronous Download:§r This action downloads files asynchronously, which means the download happens in the background without freezing or blocking the game. The game will continue running normally while the file is being downloaded.

It is also possible to access the default '.minecraft' directory with this action. For that, just start paths with the '.minecraft/' prefix.
minor.tw:
這個動作會從一個 URL 下載檔案並儲存到遊戲目錄，遊戲目錄從 Minecraft 例項目錄的根目錄開始。出於安全原因，這個動作只能在遊戲目錄內部使用。

請提供下載資料夾，而不是檔名；FancyMenu 會自動根據 HTTP 響應頭或 URL 推斷儲存的檔名。

§l非同步下載：§r這個動作會非同步下載檔案，也就是說下載會在後台進行，不會卡住或阻塞遊戲。檔案下載時遊戲會正常繼續執行。

這個動作也可以訪問預設的 ".minecraft" 目錄。只要把路徑以 ".minecraft/" 字首開頭就行。

minor.en:
This action extracts a ZIP file into a folder in the game directory, which starts at the root of the Minecraft instance directory. The target path includes the folder name the ZIP content gets extracted to, and no extra folders get created named like the ZIP file.

This action is limited to work only inside the game directory for safety reasons.

It is also possible to access the default '.minecraft' directory with this action. For that, just start paths with the '.minecraft/' prefix.

This action extracts asynchronously and triggers the 'On ZIP Extracted via Action' listener when finished.

If the screen is a §zVanilla screen§r, please §zreport§r this bug via GitHub.

Mimic the click action of a Vanilla or mod button.

You need the §lwidget locator §rof
the button you want to mimic.

To get the widget locator, right-click
the button in the editor or enable
the Debug Overlay when not in the editor
then right-click the button.

模仿原版或模組按鈕的點選動作。

你需要那個按鈕的 §l小部件定位器§r。

要獲取小部件定位器，請在編輯器裡右鍵
這個按鈕，或者在不處於編輯器時啟用

minor.en:
This action moves a file or folder in the game directory, which starts at the root of the Minecraft instance directory. This action is limited to work only inside the game directory for safety reasons.

It is also possible to access the default '.minecraft' directory with this action. For that, just start paths with the '.minecraft/' prefix.

Append '*' to the end of the source path to move every file directly inside that folder. This wildcard ignores sub-directories and requires the destination to be a directory.
minor.tw:
這個動作會在遊戲目錄中移動一個檔案或資料夾，遊戲目錄從 Minecraft 例項目錄的根目錄開始。出於安全原因，這個動作只能在遊戲目錄內部使用。

這個動作也可以訪問預設的 ".minecraft" 目錄。只要把路徑以 ".minecraft/" 字首開頭就行。

在源路徑末尾追加 '*'，可以移動該資料夾內直接包含的所有檔案。這個萬用字元會忽略子目錄，並要求目標位置必須是一個目錄。

minor.en:
§xRequires FancyMenu on the server.§r

Fetches live NBT data from the server, mirroring every target supported by '/data get'.
Returns an empty value until the server response arrives.

The placeholder works exactly like the '/data get' command, so everything that should be possible with the command should also be possible with the placeholder.

Supported source_type values:
- entity: Full selector syntax (scores, advancements, predicates, rotation, gamemode, etc.)
- block: Absolute, relative (~) or local (^) coordinates like the vanilla command
- storage: Command storage identifiers (namespace:key)

Optional arguments:
- nbt_path: Same path rules as '/data get'
- scale: Multiplies numeric results (default 1.0)
- return_type: 'value', 'string', 'snbt', or 'json'

Responses are cached for 100ms to avoid spamming the server.
minor.tw:
§x需要伺服器上也安裝 FancyMenu 才能用。§r

從伺服器獲取實時 NBT 資料，覆蓋 '/data get' 支援的所有目標。
在伺服器響應到達前返回空值。

這個佔位符的工作方式和 '/data get' 指令完全一樣，所以指令能做到的，

minor.en: Sneak + Right Click in the air to change modes. Right click a drawer to toggle the option.

minor.en: Place in an open flame if a fire dragon, underwater if ice dragon, or in rain if lightning dragon and wait a long time. The dragon will bond with the closest player.
minor.tw: 若為火龍蛋，把它放在火裡；若為冰龍蛋，把它放在水下;若為電龍蛋，把它放在雨中。龍蛋孵化需要很長的時間，新生的龍仔會認最近的玩家為主人。
minor.reason: 半形分號與全形標點混用
minor.fix: 若為火龍蛋，把它放在火裡；若為冰龍蛋，把它放在水下；若為電龍蛋，把它放在雨中。龍蛋孵化需要很長的時間，新生的龍仔會認最近的玩家為主人。

minor.en: Three for one!§r\The sudden acceleration of releasing an arrow cause it to split into three.
minor.tw: 一分為三！§r\箭矢發射時的瞬間加速可能導致其分裂為三支。

minor.en: For too long, automation possibilities have been too limited. &1Integrated Dynamics&0 aims to be the go-to mod for automating your logic systems. It does this by providing an expressive immersive logic programming experience with hooks and support for most elements of &lMinecraft&r and its modifications.
minor.tw: 長久以來, 自動化的自由度太有限了. &1動態聯合&0致力於讓你的邏輯系統更加的智慧化。 它為你提供了其最具有代表性的沉浸邏輯程式設計體驗，並且支援大部分&lMinecraft&r和Mod裡的要素。
minor.reason: Mod 未翻、半形標點
minor.fix: 長久以來，自動化的自由度太有限了。&1動態聯合&0致力於讓你的邏輯系統更加智慧化。它為你提供了最具代表性的沉浸式邏輯程式設計體驗，並且支援大部分&lMinecraft&r和模組裡的要素。

minor.en: Redstone circuits have always been a very basic, but workable and easily understandable method for automation. The basicness of redstone is however also an inconvenience. For automation networks with higher complexities, redstone circuits can become very large and consequently also difficult to manage. Furthermore, one small water-leak can cause major headaches to every redstoner.
minor.tw: 紅石電路一直以來是最基礎的, 也是一種簡單易懂的途徑來實現自動化。 然而歸根結底，它並不方便。如果想要構建一個高複雜度的自動化網路,紅石系統將會做的非常的大，並且難以設計。更要命的是，如果你不小心弄潑了一桶水，它也許能會毀掉你的整個紅石系統。
minor.reason: 「它也許能會毀掉」贅字
minor.fix: 紅石電路一直以來是最基礎、簡單易懂的自動化途徑。然而歸根結底，它並不方便。如果想要構建一個高複雜度的自動化網路，紅石系統將會做得非常大，並且難以管理。更要命的是，如果你不小心弄潑了一桶水，它也許會毀掉你的整個紅石系統。

minor.en: You can navigate through this book by clicking on the arrows at the bottom, shift clicking will flip through whole sections instead of single pages. At the start of large sections you will see a content table which will contain hyperlinks to its subsections for faster browsing. When you come across recipes, the items that are explained in this book are clickable as a fast reference to the section they are explained in. You will also notice a button at the top left of this book, which will take you to the section above your current one. The button at the top right corner will go back to the previously visited page each time when clicked.
minor.tw: 你可以透過點選手冊底部的箭頭來翻頁閱讀, 按住shift左機可一次性翻過整個目前部分。在主目錄中，您將看到一個內容一覽表，其中將包含到各個子目錄的超連結，以便你更快的查閱。 當你遇到一個配方時,如果配方里含有本書中解釋的項目可以透過點選它來進行快速的查閱。你會注意到本書的左上方也有一個按鈕,它是用於返回上級目錄的。右上角的按鈕能讓你返回到先前訪問過的頁面。
minor.reason: 「左機」應為左鍵
minor.fix: 你可以透過點選手冊底部的箭頭來翻頁閱讀，按住Shift點選可一次翻過整個章節。在大章節開頭，你會看到內容一覽表，其中含有各子章節的超連結，方便快速查閱。當你遇到配方時，本書中有解釋的物品可以點選，快速跳到說明它們的章節。你還會注意到本書左上方有一個按鈕，可返回上一層章節；右上角的按鈕每次點選都會返回先前瀏覽過的頁面。

minor.en: Certain things in &lMinecraft&r internally use the &3NBT&0 datastructure. An &3NBT&0 tag is a special kind of object that can hold multiple values of different types. For example the NBT representation of a &8Chest&0 containing all its items, the enchantment information of an &8Pickaxe&0, ...
minor.tw: 在&lMinecraft&r中,某些東西會使用&3NBT&0這種資料結構。&3NBT&0是一種特殊類型的物件,它可以容納不同類型的多個值。例如,&8儲物箱&0中儲存的所有道具,&8鎬子&0的附魔資訊等等這些都是NBT的實際體現。
minor.reason: 道具為大陸用語
minor.fix: 在&lMinecraft&r中，某些東西會使用&3NBT&0這種資料結構。&3NBT&0是一種特殊類型的物件，它可以容納不同類型的多個值。例如，&8儲物箱&0中儲存的所有物品，&8鎬子&0的附魔資訊等等。

minor.en: A value containing a reference to an &2Operator&0. Operators can be partially applied for more flexible evaluations based on the concept of &lCurrying&r. This is part of the concept of &lmetaprogramming&r (look it up, it's a thing!), where operators are treated as data by other operators. This basically allows you to create new operators yourself, which can then be used for more complex operations.
minor.tw: 包含對&2Operator(運算子)&0的引用的資料。運算子可以根據&lCurrying(柯里化)-你可能需要百度一下&r的概念部分應用於更靈活的賦值。這是&lMeta Programming(超程式設計)-你可能又需要百度一下&r這個概念的一部分,運算子將被其他運算子視為資料,這種方式幾乎允許你建立新的運算子(和邏輯),並將它用於更復雜的操作。
minor.reason: 「百度一下」非台灣用法，原文為 look it up
minor.fix: 包含對&2Operator(運算子)&0的引用的資料。運算子可以根據&lCurrying(柯里化)-你可能需要上網查一下&r的概念部分應用於更靈活的賦值。這是&lMeta Programming(超程式設計)-你可能又需要上網查一下&r這個概念的一部分，運算子將被其他運算子視為資料，這種方式幾乎允許你建立新的運算子(和邏輯)，並將它用於更複雜的操作。

minor.en: You can for example store the addition &2Operator&0 in a variable card. Do this by starting to type the operator name and selecting it from the autocomplete dropdown-list and clicking it. You can then partially apply it with one &6Integer&0 &lVariable Card&r, which will result in a new virtual operator with one input type and one output type, which internally contains a reference to that applied &6Integer&0. Applying another &6Integer&0 will result in an &6Integer&0.
minor.tw: 例如你可以將加法&2Operator(運算子)&0存入變數卡中。透過在Operator(運算子)介面入運算子名稱並從自動匹配的下拉選單中選擇它並單擊來執行此操作。 然後，您可以將其部分應用於&6Integer&0&l變數卡&r中,這將形成具有一個輸入類型和一個輸出類型的新的虛擬運算子，其內部包含對應用的&6Integer(整型)&0的引用。 應用另一個&6Integer(整型)&0將導致&6Integer&0。
minor.reason: 「介面入運算子名稱」漏「輸」字
minor.fix: 例如你可以將加法&2Operator(運算子)&0存入變數卡中。透過在Operator(運算子)介面輸入運算子名稱，並從自動匹配的下拉選單中選擇它並單擊來執行此操作。然後，您可以將其部分應用於&6Integer&0&l變數卡&r中，這將形成具有一個輸入類型和一個輸出類型的新的虛擬運算子，其內部包含對應用的&6Integer(整型)&0的引用。應用另一個&6Integer(整型)&0將導致&6Integer&0。

minor.en: When this battery is held in your inventory, &lauto-supply&r mode can be enabled by shift+right clicking. When enabled, this battery will automatically try to fill the items you are holding in your two hands with energy.
minor.tw: 當這個電池在你的包裹中時, &l自動輸出&r模式可以使用Shift+右鍵啟用. 啟用後,這個電池會嘗試輸出能量到你雙手中的物品.
minor.reason: 包裹為大陸用語
minor.fix: 當這個電池在你的物品欄中時，可以按Shift+右鍵啟用&l自動輸出&r模式。啟用後，這個電池會嘗試輸出能量到你雙手中的物品。

minor.en: This can be useful in situations where you want to log the values of a certain dynamic &lVariable Card&r, or when you don’t need the dynamic evaluation of a &lVariable Card&r anymore.
minor.tw: 在您想要記錄某個動態和變數卡資料的情況下，或者當您不再需要動態評測&l變數卡&r的情況下，這將非常有用。
minor.reason: 「動態和變數卡資料」格式碼殘缺

minor.en: &lIntegrated Dynamics&r &lnetworks&r are the basis of any good automation system. A network consists of a collection of connected &lLogic Cables&r and parts can be placed on them. These cables should be managed using a &lWrench&r. Shift+right-clicking a cable or part will remove it, while a regular right-click will disconnect it from other cables.
minor.tw: &l動態聯合&r &l網路&r是一切自動化系統的基礎。 網路有相互連線的&l邏輯線纜&r構成，一些部件可以直接安置在上面。 這些電纜應使用&l扳手&r進行管理。Shift+右擊一個線纜或者部件將其拆卸, 而常規右鍵單擊將與其他電纜中斷連線。
minor.reason: 「有」應為「由」，線纜/電纜不一致
minor.fix: &l動態聯合&r &l網路&r是一切自動化系統的基礎。網路由相互連線的&l邏輯線纜&r構成，部件可以直接安置在上面。這些線纜應使用&l扳手&r進行管理。Shift+右擊線纜或部件將其拆卸，而常規右鍵單擊將使其與其他線纜中斷連線。

minor.en: While &lMono-Directional&r connectors are useful for long-distance connections in a single direction, in some cases this might be a bit too limited.
minor.tw: 雖然&l單向聯結器&r對於單個方上的長距離連結很有用,但是在某些情況下還是有所限制。
minor.reason: 「單個方上」漏「向」
minor.fix: 雖然&l單向聯結器&r對於單一方向上的長距離連結很有用，但是在某些情況下還是有所限制。

minor.fix: 執行與容器和管道相關的操作。這不會轉移物品本身。

minor.en: Drying out blocks and items can be done using the &lDrying Basin&r. This can for instance be useful when you want to let your &lMenril Resin&r dry into &lCrystallized Menril&r.
minor.tw: 乾燥方塊和物品可以用&l洪乾池&r完成。例如，當您希望讓您的&l門瑞歐樹脂&r乾燥成&l門瑞歐結晶&r時，這可能是有用的。

minor.en: The main goal of this mod is for building control networks for automation. This is done using &lLogic Cables&r. Try making a network with ten of those cables.

minor.en: When in beam mode the staff's damage accelerates the longer the beam is held. Also, the beam will destroy blocks it comes in contact with. %%n %%nThe scroll drains %%val0 mana from the caster, %%val1 mana when using the large explosion mode, %%val2 mana when using the AOE explosion mode, and %%val3 mana per tick when using the beam mode.

minor.en: The Mystic Eyes of Insight allow the user to see more information about a target, such as its inventory, and, in the case of living creatures, their buffs, debuffs, etc. The mana cost is %%val0 per scroll.
minor.tw: 全視之魔眼可以讓你得到更多關於目標的資訊，比如目標的揹包、藥水效果等。每次使用卷軸消耗%%val0點法力。

minor.en: You can counter sympathetic magic against yourself by keeping a worm with a high kodoku value in your inventory. The higher the value, the less likely the magic will succeed against you, and there's even a chance it will be reflected to the caster.

minor.en: Using mana increases your maximum mana capacity over time - it's like exercising. You will naturally recover some mana over time, depending on how full your hunger is. Sleeping will regen a good chunk of your mana, and sleep is important, so sleep often!
minor.tw: 使用法力會增加你的法力上限 - 就和煅煉一樣。你的法力會自然恢復，恢復速度取決於你的飢餓度。 睡覺會恢復大量的法力。
minor.reason: 「煅煉」應為「鍛鍊」，且漏譯睡眠重要的句尾

minor.en: The Mahoujin Projector is also wearable! Right click with an armor item on a projector to receive a special enchantment that displays that projector's settings. Right click again to get new settings after modifying.%%n%%nAlso, you can copy and paste from projector to projector by right clicking to copy, and shift right clicking to paste with a normal stick.

minor.en: When used, mobs and players in the caster's view will lose their buffs, along with certain other qualities, depending on the mob. Water mobs will no longer breathe underwater - nether mobs will be affected by fire and lava. Endermen, Shulker boxes and the Wither will no longer be immune to arrows. Husks can catch fire in the sun. %%n %%nIt drains %%val0 mana from the caster on use.
minor.tw: 使用後施法者所視的怪物和玩家會失去其增益和特性。水生生物無法在水下呼吸 - 地獄生物會受到火焰和岩漿傷害。終界使者、界伏蚌和凋零無法免疫弓箭。屍殼會在陽光下自燃。 %%n %%n每次使用消耗施法者%%val0點法力。

minor.fix: 使用後施法者所視的怪物和玩家會失去其增益和特性。水生生物無法在水下呼吸 - 地獄生物會受到火焰和岩漿傷害。終界使者、界伏蚌和凋零怪無法免疫弓箭。屍殼會在陽光下自燃。 %%n %%n每次使用消耗施法者%%val0點法力。

This page features a very long text that will be scaled down to fit the page size.
[It has a Link](entry://modonomicon:demo/features/multiblock) to check if click detection works on scaled texts. It has [another Link](entry://modonomicon:demo/formatting/basic) for the same reason.
Finally it has a [third link](entry://modonomicon:demo/formatting/always_locked) because why not. From now on we just add some text with no particular function except to make the page longer.

minor.en:
The [#](8B0000)Undertow Array[#]() is scribed with [#](8B0000)Kelp[#]() and awakened by [#](8B0000)Redstone Dust[#](). Once active, it opens a [#](8B0000)vitaemantic current[#]() through the open column of air directly above the glyph, lifting or drowning any entity that enters, no water required.\
\
[#](8B0000)Right-click with an empty hand[#]() to reverse the flow. Upward currents push entities skyward; downward currents drag them to the bottom, mirroring a magma block's pull. The array is persistent and remembers its direction across world reloads.\
\
[#](8B0000)Scaling[#](): the strength of the current is read live from the array's own slots. Adding more [#](8B0000)Redstone Dust[#]() to the redstone slot strengthens the acceleration; adding more [#](8B0000)Kelp[#]() to the kelp slot raises the terminal velocity. Simply right-click the array with additional ingredients to stack them into place.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Tip: the Arcane Scribe Tool can inscribe arrays directly into water source blocks, so an Undertow Array can still be placed at the bottom of a pool without draining it first.[#]()
minor.tw:
[#](8B0000)暗流陣列[#]()需由[#](8B0000)海帶[#]()為基，再用[#](8B0000)紅石粉[#]()喚醒。啟用時，它會在陣列上方的空氣柱中製造一條[#](8B0000)命血氣流[#]()，抬升或拉近其中實體，且無需用水。\
\
[#](8B0000)空手右擊[#]()可反轉氣流的方向。上的氣流會將實體推向天空；下的氣流會將實體拉向地底，和岩漿塊產生的拉力類似。這種陣列能持久存在，且能在世界重新載入時記住氣流方向。\
\
[#](8B0000)規模[#]()：氣流的強度根據陣列內容物實時計算。向紅石槽放入[#](8B0000)紅石粉[#]()可增大加速度，向海帶槽放入[#](8B0000)海帶[#]()則能抬高速度上限。用對應原材料右擊陣列即可放入。\
\
[#](2E8B57)提示：奧秘銘刻工具可直接在水源中銘刻陣列，因此不抽空水池也能在池底放置暗流陣列。[#]()

minor.en:
Neo Vitae brews its own [#](4A0080)Liquified Experience[#](), so the array needs nothing else installed to work.\
\
Should your world already hold another mod's experience fluid, name it in the server config under [#](8B0000)liquified_experience.preferred_fluid[#]() and the array will read and write that instead. The same section sets how many millibuckets a single point of experience is worth.
minor.tw:
NeoVitae有其自身的[#](4A0080)液態經驗[#]()，因此這種陣列不需安裝其他模組就能運作。\
\
若你所在的世界已有來自其他模組的經驗流體，可在服務端配置的[#](8B0000)liquified_experience.preferred_fluid[#]()下列出，陣列會轉而使用那種流體作為互動方式。配置檔案中同一節還可設定1點經驗對應多少毫桶的流體。

minor.en:
The [#](8B0000)Air Sigil[#]() hurls you through the sky in whatever direction you face, trading 50 [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() for each burst of momentum. The wind obeys, but gravity does not; this sigil offers no protection from the landing.\
\
[#](2E8B57)More than one overconfident apprentice has drained their [#](8B0000)Anima[#]() mid-flight. Know your reserves before you leap.[#]()
minor.tw:
[#](8B0000)氣之印記[#]()能向你的面朝的方向推動你自己，每次給予動量需花費50點[#](4A0080)生命源質[#]()。強風會遵循你的號令，但重力不會；這枚印記不會為著陸提供緩衝。\
\
[#](2E8B57)已經有不止一位過於自信的學徒在飛行途中耗幹了[#](8B0000)本魂[#](2E8B57)。騰空之前要檢查儲庫。[#]()
minor.reason: 「耗幹」為簡轉繁錯字。
minor.fix:
[#](8B0000)氣之印記[#]()能向你的面朝的方向推動你自己，每次給予動量需花費50點[#](4A0080)生命源質[#]()。強風會遵循你的號令，但重力不會；這枚印記不會為著陸提供緩衝。\
\

minor.en:
The sigil remembers a [#](8B0000)brightness level[#]() from 1 to 15. Left-click the air to cycle the brightness upward. Sneak and left-click to cycle it downward. The current setting is shown in the sigil's tooltip.\
\
Once a blood light has been placed, you can also adjust it directly. Right-click an existing blood light with an empty hand to increase its brightness, or sneak and right-click to dim it.
minor.tw:
印記會記憶從1到15的[#](8B0000)亮度等級[#]()。左擊空氣可向調亮方向迴圈調整，潛行左擊則向調暗。目前設定會顯示於印記的提示文字。\
\
血光放置後可直接調整。空手右擊已存在的血光可增加其亮度，潛行右擊可調暗。
minor.reason: 「迴圈」為大陸用語（cycle）。
minor.fix:
印記會記憶從1到15的[#](8B0000)亮度等級[#]()。左擊空氣可向調亮方向循環調整，潛行左擊則向調暗。目前設定會顯示於印記的提示文字。\
\
血光放置後可直接調整。空手右擊已存在的血光可增加其亮度，潛行右擊可調暗。

minor.en:
The [#](8B0000)Sigil of Bound Treasures[#]() links to a container and allows you to access its contents from anywhere. [#](8B0000)Shift right-click[#]() a chest, barrel, or any other container to bind it to the sigil. Then [#](8B0000)right-click[#]() in the air to open the linked container remotely at a cost of [#](4A0080)200 EV[#]().\
\
The linked container must be in a loaded chunk to be accessed. If the container is destroyed, the link is broken.
minor.tw:
[#](8B0000)庫藏印記[#]()可與容器連結，而後便無論身處何處都能訪問。[#](8B0000)Shift右擊[#]()儲物箱、木桶，或任意其他容器以和印記繫結。之後對空氣[#](8B0000)右擊[#]()可遠端開啟相連結的容器，消耗[#](4A0080)200 EV[#]()。\
\
相連結的容器只有處於已載入的區塊才能訪問。容器被摧毀之時，連結也會斷裂。
minor.reason: 「訪問」為大陸用語。

[#](8B0000)庫藏印記[#]()可與容器連結，而後便無論身處何處都能存取。[#](8B0000)Shift右擊[#]()儲物箱、木桶，或任意其他容器以和印記繫結。之後對空氣[#](8B0000)右擊[#]()可遠端開啟相連結的容器，消耗[#](4A0080)200 EV[#]()。\

minor.en: Hold sneak and press [Use] to open a configuration interface. Here you may reposition the various [#](4A0080)Vitaemancy[#]() display elements on your field of vision. Click and drag to move them, then select Save to preserve the arrangement, or Default to restore the original positions.
minor.tw: 按住潛行鍵再按下[使用]，可開啟配置介面。其中可以調整視野中多種[#](4A0080)命血術[#]()顯示件的位置。點選拖拽，再點選「儲存」，即可儲存佈局；或也可點選「恢復預設」以重設為原本的位置。
minor.reason: 「拖拽」為大陸用語。
minor.fix: 按住潛行鍵再按下[使用]，可開啟配置介面。其中可以調整視野中多種[#](4A0080)命血術[#]()顯示件的位置。點選拖曳，再點選「儲存」，即可儲存佈局；或也可點選「恢復預設」以重設為原本的位置。

minor.en:
Aim at a growable block and press [Use] to apply a burst of growth for 150 [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]().\
\
Alternatively, hold sneak and press [Use] to toggle a persistent aura. While active, every block within a 7x7x5 volume centered on you receives a growth pulse every 5 seconds, at a cost of 150 [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() per cycle.
minor.tw:
看向能生長的方塊再按下[使用]，可讓其猛烈成長，需消耗150點[#](4A0080)生命源質[#]()。\
\
也可按住潛行鍵再按下[使用]以開關永續性促生靈氣氛圍。啟用時，以你為中心7x7x5區域內的所有方塊每5秒會收到一次生長脈衝，每次迴圈消耗150點[#](4A0080)生命源質[#]()。
minor.reason: 「迴圈」為大陸用語。
minor.fix:
看向能生長的方塊再按下[使用]，可讓其猛烈成長，需消耗150點[#](4A0080)生命源質[#]()。\
\
也可按住潛行鍵再按下[使用]以開關永續性促生靈氣氛圍。啟用時，以你為中心7x7x5區域內的所有方塊每5秒會收到一次生長脈衝，每次週期消耗150點[#](4A0080)生命源質[#]()。

minor.en:
The [#](8B0000)Void Sigil[#]() annihilates fluid on contact, consuming 50 [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() per block erased. Aim at any liquid and press [Use] to watch it vanish without a trace.\
\
Invaluable for clearing treacherous lava flows or unwanted floods without the tedium of conventional methods.
minor.tw:
[#](8B0000)虛空印記[#]()能在接觸消滅流體，每清除一個方塊消耗50點[#](4A0080)生命源質[#]()。看向任意流體並按下[使用]，流體便會不留痕跡地消失。\
\
用它清理難以控制的熔岩，排幹無人想要的洪水，可免去常規手段的勞累。
minor.reason: 「排幹」簡轉繁錯字；「在接觸消滅」缺「時」。
minor.fix:
[#](8B0000)虛空印記[#]()能在接觸時消滅流體，每清除一個方塊消耗50點[#](4A0080)生命源質[#]()。看向任意流體並按下[使用]，流體便會不留痕跡地消失。\
\
用它清理難以控制的熔岩，排乾無人想要的洪水，可免去常規手段的勞累。

minor.en:
The [#](8B0000)Teleposition Array[#]() folds space between two aligned glyphs, creating a seamless vertical transit system. A single array does nothing on its own you must place [#](8B0000)at least two[#]() arrays directly above one another, aligned on the same block column, at any distance up to [#](B8860B)64 blocks[#]().\
\
[#](B8860B)Jump[#]() while standing on an array to teleport upward to the next array above. [#](B8860B)Sneak[#]() to descend to the nearest array below.
minor.tw:
[#](8B0000)轉位陣列[#]()能摺疊正上正下方陣列之間的空間，可用作縱向交通手段。單個陣列沒有實際功能，必須[#](8B0000)至少[#]()在垂直方上銘刻[#](8B0000)兩個陣列[#]()，距離最遠可為[#](B8860B)64格[#]()。\
\
站在陣列上[#](B8860B)跳躍[#]()可上傳送至最近的陣列。[#](B8860B)潛行[#]()可下傳送。
minor.reason: 「垂直方上」缺「向」，「上傳送／下傳送」生硬。
minor.fix:
[#](8B0000)轉位陣列[#]()能摺疊正上正下方陣列之間的空間，可用作縱向交通手段。單個陣列沒有實際功能，必須[#](8B0000)至少[#]()在垂直方向上銘刻[#](8B0000)兩個陣列[#]()，距離最遠可為[#](B8860B)64格[#]()。\
\
站在陣列上[#](B8860B)跳躍[#]()可向上傳送至最近的陣列。[#](B8860B)潛行[#]()可向下傳送。

minor.en:
Sigils fall into two schools of invocation:

- [#](8B0000)Use-on-cast[#]() sigils such as the [#](8B0000)Water[#](), [#](8B0000)Lava[#](), [#](8B0000)Void[#](), and [#](8B0000)Blood Lamp Sigils[#]() perform a single act each time you invoke them, drawing a fixed measure of [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() per use.

- [#](8B0000)Toggleable[#]() sigils maintain a continuous effect while held active. They draw [#](4A0080)EV[#]() at a steady upkeep so long as their power flows.
minor.tw:
印記可按使用方法分為兩類：

- [#](8B0000)觸發式[#]()印記，
如[#](8B0000)水之印記[#]()、[#](8B0000)熔岩印記[#]()、[#](8B0000)虛空印記[#]()、[#](8B0000)血光印記[#]()等，會在每次喚起時執行單次操作，每次使用消耗固定量的[#](4A0080)生命源質[#]()。

- [#](8B0000)開關式[#]()印記，
啟用時會持續產生效果。只要這類印記處於運作狀態，就會以穩定速度消耗[#](4A0080)EV[#]()。
minor.reason: tw 多出 en 沒有的換行（「印記，」後各多一個 \n）。

minor.en:
The sigil serves two vital purposes:

- Activate it toward open air to reveal the [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() stored within your [#](8B0000)Anima[#](), the measure of your reserves.

- Aim it at an [#](8B0000)Ara Vitae[#]() to reveal the altar's current tier, the volume of [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() within, and its maximum capacity.
minor.tw:
占卜印記有兩個重要功能：

- 對空氣觸發，
可揭示你[#](8B0000)本魂[#]()中的[#](4A0080)生命源質[#]()，即檢視你自身儲庫的餘量。

- 看向[#](8B0000)命血祭壇[#]()，
可揭示祭壇目前的層級，其中[#](4A0080)生命源質[#]()的體積，以及祭壇的最大容量。

minor.en:
When aimed at an [#](8B0000)Ara Vitae[#](), the Seer's display reveals, from top to bottom:

- The altar's current [#](B8860B)Tier[#]()

- Current [#](4A0080)EV[#]() volume and total capacity

- Active crafting progress, if any

- [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() consumed per tick during crafting

- Current [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() reserve held by Charging Runes
minor.tw:
看向[#](8B0000)命血祭壇[#]()時，先知印記會揭示的內容從上到下為：

- 祭壇的目前[#](B8860B)層級[#]()

- 目前[#](4A0080)EV[#]()體積和總容量

- 目前合成進度，若有

[#](4A0080)生命源質[#]()

minor.en:
[#](8B0000)Sneak and use[#]() the Link to cycle its craft tier. A Link can never reach the altar it serves; it caps [#](8B0000)one tier below[#](). Bind to a tier-five altar and the Link may climb to four, no further, then wraps back to zero.\
\
Should the altar lose a ring and drop a tier, the Link follows it down. Should the altar grow, the Link stays where you set it.
minor.tw:
[#](8B0000)潛行使用[#]()連結可迴圈切換合成層級。連結永遠無法達到祭壇的層級，最多能到比祭壇[#](8B0000)低一級[#]()處。繫結至5級祭壇後，連結最高可達4級，隨後再次切換隻會回到0級。\
\
若祭壇損失了一道符文環，降了一級，連結也會跟隨其降低版本。祭壇升級時，連結則會保持在你設定的層級。
minor.reason: 「切換隻會」錯字（只）；「迴圈」為大陸用語；「降低版本」誤譯 drop a tier。
minor.fix:
[#](8B0000)潛行使用[#]()連結可循環切換合成層級。連結永遠無法達到祭壇的層級，最多能到比祭壇[#](8B0000)低一級[#]()處。繫結至5級祭壇後，連結最高可達4級，隨後再次切換只會回到0級。\
\
若祭壇損失了一道符文環，降了一級，連結也會跟著降級。祭壇升級時，連結則會保持在你設定的層級。

minor.en:
The [#](2E8B57)Pestilence Spider[#](). A venomous creature with fang bites and shadow lunges. Low health (30 HP) but its poison is deadly in groups.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Drops[#](): Venomgland Sac, Tainted Flesh, Spider Eye, String
minor.tw:
[#](2E8B57)蟲蠱蜘蛛[#]()。有劇毒的生物，能用尖牙啃咬，也能發起暗影俯衝。生命值較低（30 HP），但成群后它的劇毒不容小覷。\
\
[#](2E8B57)掉落物[#]()：毒腺囊、染汙血肉、蜘蛛眼、線
minor.reason: 「成群后」應為「成群後」。

minor.en:
[#](8B0000)Hollow Gut[#]() (Voraxis): A distended organ that never fills, used in hunger and drain recipes.\
\
[#](8B0000)Blight Marrow[#]() (Corrodis): Corroded bone seeping dark mist, key to wither and Ruina crafting.\
\
[#](8B0000)Revenant Plate[#]() (Fervidis): A chunk of undying chitin, prized for defensive and armor crafting.\
\
[#](8B0000)Frozen Marrow Shard[#]() (Doloris): Ice-veined bone, combining cold and anguish in a single reagent.
minor.tw:
[#](8B0000)中空腸道[#]()（貪食）：腫脹的器官，永遠無法被填滿，用於與飢餓和抽取有關的配方。\
\
[#](8B0000)枯萎骨髓[#]()（腐壞）：被腐蝕的骨頭，滲著黑霧，是與凋零和殘毀靈質有關合成的關鍵。\
\
[#](8B0000)亡魂之板[#]()（不死）：一片不死的甲殼，在防禦裝置和盔甲製造中舉足輕重。\
\
[#](8B0000)凍結骨髓碎片[#]()（苦痛）：嵌者冰結脈絡的骨頭，統一了寒冷與痛苦的試劑。

minor.en: Delve deep enough and fortune may smile upon you with [#](8B0000)Intricate Hellforged Parts[#](). These rare components can be used to [#](4A0080)double the potency[#]() of your existing [#](8B0000)Runes[#](), effectively granting the power of two Ara Vitaes in a single structure.
minor.tw: 若探索地足夠深入，你便有可能氣運傍身，找到[#](8B0000)繁複獄鍛零件[#]()。這些稀有的零件可用讓[#](8B0000)符文[#]()的[#](4A0080)效力翻倍[#]()，相當於能在同一個結構中塞下兩張命血祭壇。
minor.reason: 「探索地足夠深入」應為「得」；「可用讓」不通順。
minor.fix: 若探索得足夠深入，你便有可能氣運傍身，找到[#](8B0000)繁複獄鍛零件[#]()。這些稀有的零件可用來讓[#](8B0000)符文[#]()的[#](4A0080)效力翻倍[#]()，相當於能在同一個結構中塞下兩張命血祭壇。

minor.en: There exists a darker method of cultivation. If a [#](4A0080)living creature[#]() stands atop the plant as it matures, the Tau vine will draw upon the creature's vitality to feed its own growth. The result is [#](8B0000)Saturated Tau[#](), a far more potent variant born from stolen life.
minor.tw: 還有一種更黑暗的培育方法。在它成熟時若上方站有[#](4A0080)生物[#]()，血命藤即會抽取生物的生命力，供養自身生長。此時結出的果實是[#](8B0000)飽滿血命果[#]()，比只是偷取生命而長成的正常血命果要強大許多。
minor.reason: en 是飽滿血命果由偷取生命而生、比一般更強；tw 寫成一般血命果「只是偷取生命而長成」，語意顛倒。

minor.en:
On a populated server, [#](8B0000)the Well of Suffering[#]() strains under the weight of every player's mob farm. Dozens or hundreds of mobs spawned, killed, and dropped at once, each dragging the tick rate down a little further.\
\
[#](4A0080)The Torment Nexus[#]() exists so endgame practitioners can extract the same EV stream without spawning a single mob. The kills are simulated. The chunks stay quiet. The server stays playable.
minor.tw:
在人數繁多的服務端中，[#](8B0000)苦難之井[#]()會在所有玩家的生物農場影響下不堪重負。同一時刻會有成百上千個生物被生成、被擊殺、產出掉落物，每一次重新整理都會拖慢刻速率，最終引發卡頓。\
\
[#](4A0080)磨難樞紐[#]()的存在正是為方便遊戲後期的習藝者產出EV。無需生成生物，擊殺完全由模擬而來。區塊不會變得擁擠，服務端也不會承受巨量負擔。
minor.reason: 「服務端」應為伺服器；「每一次重新整理…最終引發卡頓」與原文 each dragging the tick rate down 不符（誤譯並增添）。
minor.fix:
在人數繁多的伺服器中，[#](8B0000)苦難之井[#]()會在所有玩家的生物農場影響下不堪重負。同一時刻會有成百上千個生物被生成、被擊殺、產出掉落物，每一個都會進一步拖慢刻速率。\
\
[#](4A0080)磨難樞紐[#]()的存在正是為方便遊戲後期的習藝者產出EV。無需生成生物，擊殺完全由模擬而來。區塊不會變得擁擠，伺服器也不會承受巨量負擔。

minor.en:
Two server-config knobs balance the ritual:\
\
[#](8B0000)ev_per_kill[#](): EV deducted from your network per simulated kill (default 75).\
[#](8B0000)ev_modifier_percent[#](): scales the EV deposited per kill from 1 (1%%) to 1000 (10x). Pack authors can crank this down to make the ritual a quality-of-life replacement for old farms, or up to make it a true endgame multiplier.\
\
Range can be tuned with the [#](2E8B57)Ritual Configurator[#]() per ritual stone.
minor.tw:
服務端配置中有兩項可對儀式進行平衡：\
\
[#](8B0000)ev_per_kill[#]()：每次模擬擊殺時消耗的EV量（預設75）。\
[#](8B0000)ev_modifier_percent[#]()：每次擊殺的EV產出倍率，從1（1%%）到1000（10倍）。整合包作者可調低此值，讓儀式成為其他生物農場的上位替代；也可調高此值，讓儀式真正成為遊戲後期的機器。\
\
範圍可用[#](2E8B57)儀式配置杖[#]()調整。
minor.reason: 「服務端」應為伺服器。
minor.fix:
伺服器配置中有兩項可對儀式進行平衡：\
\
[#](8B0000)ev_per_kill[#]()：每次模擬擊殺時消耗的EV量（預設75）。\
[#](8B0000)ev_modifier_percent[#]()：每次擊殺的EV產出倍率，從1（1%%）到1000（10倍）。整合包作者可調低此值，讓儀式成為其他生物農場的上位替代；也可調高此值，讓儀式真正成為遊戲後期的機器。\
\
範圍可用[#](2E8B57)儀式配置杖[#]()調整。

minor.en:
- [#](8B0000)Define Area[#](): Specifies the zone in which the ritual operates, and displays the current boundaries. Press Sneak and Use in the air to cycle through a ritual's zones, then click two opposite corners to reshape the selected one.\
\
Rituals that draw from or deposit into a container expose their [#](8B0000)chest[#](), [#](8B0000)tank[#](), or input/output zone here too, so you can place that container wherever you like instead of directly atop the [#](8B0000)Master Ritual Stone[#]().\
\
[#](2E8B57)Some rituals can be expanded far beyond their default range, but the EV cost scales to match. Tread carefully with your reserves.[#]()
minor.tw:
- [#](8B0000)選定區域[#]()：
指定儀式運作的區域，並顯示目前區域的邊界。對空氣潛行使用可迴圈切換目前操作儀式的哪一個區域，此時選擇兩個相對的角點，即可為儀式重新指定區域。\
\
會對容器存取的儀式也會在此公開其[#](8B0000)儲物箱[#]()、[#](8B0000)儲罐[#]()或輸入/輸出區域。以便調整容器的位置，而不需要全部預設放置在[#](8B0000)主儀式石[#]()上方。\
\
[#](2E8B57)部分儀式可擴充至遠超預設範圍，但也會相應增加EV消耗。要規劃好你的儲庫。[#]()
minor.reason: 「迴圈切換」為大陸用語；「選定區域」後多出一個換行；「全部預設放置在…上方」語意不順。

minor.en: The [#](8B0000)Ritual Configurator[#]() is an essential instrument for the practitioner who demands mastery over their [#](4A0080)ritual circles[#](). It offers three modes of interaction, each granting deeper control. Cycle between them by pressing Sneak and Use.
minor.tw: [#](8B0000)儀式配置杖[#]()是習藝者掌控[#](4A0080)儀式石陣[#]()所必不可少的工具。它有三種互動模式，每一種都能進行更深入細緻的控制。潛行使用可迴圈切換模式。
minor.reason: 「迴圈切換」為大陸用語。

minor.en:
- [#](8B0000)Information[#](): Reveals the purpose of the selected [#](4A0080)ritual[#](), much like the [#](8B0000)Ritual Diviner[#]().

- [#](8B0000)Set Spiritus Consumed[#](): Attunes the ritual to consume specific types of [#](8B0000)Spiritus[#]() from the [#](4A0080)Aura[#](). Carry the desired [#](8B0000)Spiritus Crystals[#]() in your hotbar, one for each aspect you wish the ritual to draw upon. The effects of each spiritus type are detailed on individual ritual pages.
minor.tw:
- [#](8B0000)資訊[#]()：
揭示所選[#](4A0080)儀式[#]()的功效，和[#](8B0000)儀式占卜杖[#]()類似。

- [#](8B0000)設定所消耗的靈質[#]()：
將儀式精校為消耗[#](4A0080)靈域[#]()中特定種類的[#](8B0000)靈質[#]()。可在快捷欄中放置[#](8B0000)靈質結晶[#]()，每種希望儀式取用的要素放置一枚。儀式頁面中會記錄不同靈質的效果。
minor.reason: 「快捷欄」台灣用「快捷列」。

minor.en:
[#](2E8B57)The Aura is chunk-based.[#]() Spiritus burned in one chunk fills only that chunk, up to a cap of [#](B8860B)100[#]() for each Aspect. Measure the local concentration with a [#](8B0000)Spiritus Aura Gauge[#]().\
\
To move Spiritus across distances, place a [#](8B0000)Spiritus Conduit[#](). It draws Spiritus toward itself from 16 blocks away in each cardinal direction, and multiple pylons can be chained for long-distance transfer.
minor.tw:
[#](2E8B57)靈域按區塊分佈。[#]()燃燒釋放的靈質最多隻會在它所處的區塊內擴散，每個要素最多可擴散[#](B8860B)100[#]()份。可用[#](8B0000)靈域測量儀[#]()測量本機靈質濃度。\
\
若要將靈質擴散得更遠，可放置[#](8B0000)靈質導能塔[#]()。它能將東南西北四個方上16格內的靈質抽到它所處的區塊中，可連續放置多個導能塔以進行長距離傳輸。
minor.reason: 「四個方上」缺字（方向）；「本機」「最多隻」用語不自然。
minor.fix:
[#](2E8B57)靈域按區塊分佈。[#]()燃燒釋放的靈質最多只會在它所處的區塊內擴散，每個要素最多可擴散[#](B8860B)100[#]()份。可用[#](8B0000)靈域測量儀[#]()測量所在區塊的靈質濃度。\
\
若要將靈質擴散得更遠，可放置[#](8B0000)靈質導能塔[#]()。它能將東南西北四個方向上16格內的靈質抽到它所處的區塊中，可連續放置多個導能塔以進行長距離傳輸。

minor.en:
The overlay appears at the top-left of your vision. The colored bars offer a quick estimate of each [#](4A0080)Aspect's[#]() concentration in the current chunk.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Hold sneak for a precise numerical reading; values range from 0 to 100 for each Aspect. 100 is the maximum a single chunk can contain.[#]()
minor.tw:
覆蓋層位於視野左上角。彩色的橫條可用於快捷判斷目前區塊中各[#](4A0080)要素[#]()的丰度。\
\
[#](2E8B57)按住潛行鍵會顯示數值讀數，各要素的讀數均在0到100之間。100是單個區塊中單種要素的最大含量。[#]()

minor.en:
Place the item to enchant in the [#](8B0000)Hellfire Forge[#]() alongside a [#](4A0080)Tabula Robur[#](), [#](4A0080)Lapis Lazuli[#](), and [#](4A0080)Nether Wart[#](). The forge requires a minimum of [#](8B0000)400 Spiritus[#]() and will consume [#](8B0000)200 Spiritus[#]() in the process.\
\
The item will retain all of its existing enchantments and properties.
minor.reason: Nether Wart 台灣官方譯名為「地獄疣」。

minor.en:
The [#](8B0000)Blood Tank[#]() is a portable reservoir, capable of holding [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() and other fluids. Fill or drain it by right-clicking with a bucket or similar vessel. The tank faithfully retains its contents when broken, making it ideal for transporting large volumes between locations.\
\
It glows faintly according to its contents. Each tier doubles the previous capacity, beginning at [#](B8860B)16 Buckets[#]() and reaching a staggering [#](B8860B)524,288 Buckets[#]() at tier 16.
minor.tw:
[#](8B0000)氣血儲罐[#]()是行動式的儲庫，能夠容納[#](4A0080)生命源質[#]()和其他流體。以鐵桶及類似容器右擊可填充和抽取。儲罐被破壞時會忠實地保留其內容物，是在不同位置間搬運大量流體的理想裝置。\
\
它會根據內容物發出淡淡的光。每一層級的容量都是前一層級的兩倍，1級為[#](B8860B)16桶[#]()，到16級則能累積到足足[#](B8860B)524,288桶[#]()。

minor.en:
Combine two [#](8B0000)Blood Tanks[#]() with [#](8B0000)Glass[#]() and a [#](8B0000)Bloodstone[#]() in a crafting table. The resulting tank rises one tier above the primary input, and both tanks' fluid contents merge together.\
\
If both tanks hold the same fluid, volumes are added. If only one contains fluid, the result retains it. If they hold different fluids, the primary tank's contents take precedence.
minor.tw:
在工作台中將[#](8B0000)氣血儲罐[#]()和[#](8B0000)玻璃[#]()及一塊[#](8B0000)血石[#]()組合。所得儲罐會比主儲罐高出一級，同時合併兩儲罐的內容流體。\
\
若兩儲罐裝有同種流體，則直接合並體積。若只有一個裝有流體，則取它的內容物。若兩者流體不同，則取主儲罐的內容物。
minor.reason: 「合並」應為「合併」。

minor.en:
Spires grow whenever the chunk holds at least a trace of the cluster's Aspect; growth scales with saturation, accelerating as the Aura fills. A chunk's natural cap is [#](B8860B)100[#]() per Aspect, though certain Rituals can raise it.\
\
Each new spire costs [#](B8860B)45 Spiritus[#]() when the chunk's dominant Aspect matches the cluster, and yields 50 when burned in a Spiritus Crucible, a net gain of 5 per spire. If the chunk's dominant Aspect [#](2E8B57)does not match[#]() the cluster (for instance, a Raw chunk feeding a Ruina cluster), the cost rises to [#](B8860B)90 Spiritus[#]() per spire and growth runs at [#](B8860B)60%% speed[#](). Keep the chunk biased toward the Aspect you want to farm.
minor.tw:
晶枝會在區塊內含有對應要素靈質時不斷生長；只要有就會生長，但飽食程度越高生長得就越快。區塊中單種要素的自然上限是[#](B8860B)100[#]()份，某些儀式能讓靈域超過這個上限。\
\
晶簇每長出一根新晶枝，都需要消耗[#](B8860B)45份[#]()區塊中同種要素（需佔主導地位）的靈質；晶枝可在靈質坩堝中可燃燒為50份，每根淨產出5份。若區塊的主導要素和晶簇[#](2E8B57)不同[#]()（如原生區塊和殘毀晶簇），消耗會增加至每根晶枝[#](B8860B)90份靈質[#]()，且生長速度變為原本的[#](B8860B)60%%[#]()。務必讓區塊的靈域偏向你希望培育的要素。

minor.en:
Crafting in the Forge spends the [#](8B0000)Spiritus[#]() held in its [#](8B0000)Spiritus Gem[#](). Left to itself that reserve would soon run dry, so the Forge draws upon its surroundings: a gem seated in the Forge steadily drinks [#](8B0000)Spiritus[#]() from the chunk's [#](4A0080)Aura[#](), at the same pace a [#](8B0000)Spiritus Crucible[#]() would fill it.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Feed the local Aura with a Crystallum Fractura farm and the Forge can craft unattended, its gem refilling as quickly as it is spent.[#]()
minor.tw:
鍛爐的合成會消耗其[#](8B0000)靈質寶石[#]()中的[#](8B0000)靈質[#]()，若是放著不管，很快就會耗幹，所以鍛爐會從環境中抽取彌補：鍛爐中的寶石會吸收區塊[#](4A0080)靈域[#]()中的[#](8B0000)靈質[#]()，速度和在[#](8B0000)靈質坩堝[#]()中的一致。\
\
[#](2E8B57)用結晶碎裂農場補充本機靈域，即可讓鍛爐自行運作，寶石的消耗速度會和補充速度持平。[#]()

minor.en:
The [#](8B0000)Levitation[#]() elixir reverses the pull of the earth, causing the drinker to rise helplessly skyward. Higher levels accelerate the ascent. Use with care; what goes up must eventually come down.\
\
Derived from a flask of [#](8B0000)Slow Falling[#]().
minor.tw:
[#](8B0000)懸浮[#]()靈藥能反轉重力的方向，讓服用者不停飄上天空。高等級下上升速度加快。使用需謹慎，懸浮的事物終會迴歸大地。\
\
釀造自[#](8B0000)緩降[#]()靈藥。
minor.reason: Levitation 官方為「漂浮」，且與 Suspended 的「懸浮」撞名
minor.fix:
[#](8B0000)漂浮[#]()靈藥能反轉重力的方向，讓服用者不停飄上天空。高等級下上升速度加快。使用需謹慎，懸浮的事物終會迴歸大地。\
\
釀造自[#](8B0000)緩降[#]()靈藥。

minor.en: A charged gem can do more than hoard malice. Crouch and right-click a [#](8B0000)Monster Spawner[#]() or [#](8B0000)Trial Spawner[#]() with a gem holding at least [#](8B0000)200 Spiritus[#](), and that reserve is spent to wrench the block free of the world. It drops as an item, its bound creature and settings carried with it, ready to be set down again wherever you please.
minor.tw: 充有靈質的寶石不只能用來囤積惡意。潛行時，用包含至少[#](8B0000)200份靈質[#]()的寶石右擊[#](8B0000)生怪磚[#]()或[#](8B0000)試煉生怪磚[#]()，即可消耗同樣數量的靈質將方塊撬下。生怪磚會掉落為物品，保留其中的生物精華和設定，隨後即可安放到別處去。
minor.reason: bound creature 譯成「生物精華」，原文無此物
minor.fix: 充有靈質的寶石不只能用來囤積惡意。潛行時，用包含至少[#](8B0000)200份靈質[#]()的寶石右擊[#](8B0000)生怪磚[#]()或[#](8B0000)試煉生怪磚[#]()，即可消耗同樣數量的靈質將方塊撬下。生怪磚會掉落為物品，保留其綁定的生物和設定，隨後即可安放到別處去。

minor.en:
Infused equipment stores [#](4A0080)Spiritus[#]() directly, eliminating the need to carry separate gems. The stored spiritus is drawn upon by [#](8B0000)Sentient Tools[#]() and other spiritus-consuming effects just as it would be from a gem in your inventory.\
\
A colored bar at the top of the item icon indicates the current charge level. The bar color reflects the spiritus type stored. Equipment can be recharged via a [#](8B0000)Spiritus Crucible[#]() or by absorbing monster souls.
minor.tw:
灌注裝備自身就能儲存[#](4A0080)靈質[#]()，不需要再單獨攜帶寶石了。儲存的靈質可被[#](8B0000)感知工具[#]()及其他消耗靈質的效果取用，和向物品欄中的寶石取用一致。\
\
物品圖示頂部的帶色橫條可顯示目前存量水平。橫條的顏色則反映出所存源質的類型。這些裝備可在[#](8B0000)靈質坩堝[#]()中充能，也可透過吸收怪物的靈魂充能。
minor.reason: spiritus type 誤譯為「源質」(Essence)，應為靈質
minor.fix:
灌注裝備自身就能儲存[#](4A0080)靈質[#]()，不需要再單獨攜帶寶石了。儲存的靈質可被[#](8B0000)感知工具[#]()及其他消耗靈質的效果取用，和向物品欄中的寶石取用一致。\
\

minor.en: Stacks to 19, one for each tick that can be shaved from the cycle. A peculiar limit, perhaps, but the fabric of reality can only be bent so far.
minor.tw: 最多升級19次，每一次都能將間隔縮短1刻。這種限制確實很奇怪，也許是因為現實的構造只允許我加速到這種程度。
minor.reason: 多出「我」，原文無第一人稱
minor.fix: 最多升級19次，每一次都能將間隔縮短1刻。這種限制確實很奇怪，也許是因為現實的構造只能被扭曲到這種程度。

minor.en: The [#](8B0000)Hard Cloak[#]() elixir stiffens the wearer's skin and armor alike, granting 3 points of Armor Toughness per level. Blows that would pierce through find an unexpected resilience beneath.
minor.tw: [#](8B0000)堅固披風[#]()靈藥能加固服用者的肌膚和盔甲，每級可給予3點盔甲強度。本會直接貫穿的攻擊如今將被堅韌的屏障擋下。
minor.reason: Armor Toughness 台灣為「盔甲韌性」
minor.fix: [#](8B0000)堅固披風[#]()靈藥能加固服用者的肌膚和盔甲，每級可給予3點盔甲韌性。本會直接貫穿的攻擊如今將被堅韌的屏障擋下。

minor.en:
The [#](8B0000)Heavy Heart[#]() elixir fills the chest with a leaden weight that drags the victim steadily downward. Flight becomes a desperate struggle. Swimming becomes a slow drowning.\
\
To synthesize it, brew both [#](8B0000)Gravity[#]() and [#](8B0000)Instant Health[#]() into a single flask, then fuse them with a [#](8B0000)Combinational Catalyst[#]() at the Tabula Vitae.
minor.tw:
[#](8B0000)沉重心緒[#]()靈藥會讓服用者內心變得壓抑沉重，以至於軀體會下方墜落。飛行成為了無望的掙扎，游泳則不過是緩速的溺亡。\
\
將[#](8B0000)重力[#]()靈藥和[#](8B0000)立即治療[#]()靈藥釀造至同一個藥水瓶，再在命血台桌處以[#](8B0000)融合觸媒[#]()融合兩者，即可製成此靈藥。
minor.reason: 「會下方墜落」語病；Instant Health 台灣為「瞬間治療」
minor.fix:
[#](8B0000)沉重心緒[#]()靈藥會讓服用者內心變得壓抑沉重，以至於軀體會向下墜落。飛行成為了無望的掙扎，游泳則不過是緩速的溺亡。\
\
將[#](8B0000)重力[#]()靈藥和[#](8B0000)瞬間治療[#]()靈藥釀造至同一個藥水瓶，再在命血台桌處以[#](8B0000)融合觸媒[#]()融合兩者，即可製成此靈藥。

minor.en:
The [#](8B0000)Instant Damage[#]() elixir is vitality inverted, a concentrated bolt of [#](4A0080)arcane harm[#]() that inflicts 6 points of magic damage per level. The [#](8B0000)undead[#](), paradoxically, find succour in it, healing 6 points per level instead.\
\
Derived from a flask of either [#](8B0000)Instant Health[#]() or [#](8B0000)Poison[#]().
minor.tw:
[#](8B0000)立即傷害[#]()靈藥是反轉的生命力，是能造成[#](4A0080)奧術傷害[#]()的兵刃，每級造成6點魔法傷害。而[#](8B0000)亡靈[#]()是個例外，它們能從中獲取強力，每級恢復6點生命值。\
\
釀造自[#](8B0000)立即治療[#]()靈藥或[#](8B0000)劇毒[#]()靈藥。
minor.reason: Instant Damage/Health 台灣為「瞬間傷害／瞬間治療」
minor.fix:
[#](8B0000)瞬間傷害[#]()靈藥是反轉的生命力，是能造成[#](4A0080)奧術傷害[#]()的兵刃，每級造成6點魔法傷害。而[#](8B0000)亡靈[#]()是個例外，它們能從中獲取強力，每級恢復6點生命值。\
\
釀造自[#](8B0000)瞬間治療[#]()靈藥或[#](8B0000)劇毒[#]()靈藥。

minor.en: The [#](8B0000)Instant Health[#]() elixir is no gentle salve; it floods the body with raw vitality, restoring 4 health per level in an instant. Against the [#](8B0000)undead[#](), this same vitality becomes anathema, dealing 4 points of harm per level instead.
minor.tw: [#](8B0000)立即治療[#]()靈藥不是什麼溫和的藥劑；它會向軀體注入原生的生命力，每級可瞬間恢復4點生命值。但對[#](8B0000)亡靈[#]()而言，這種生命力卻成了詛咒，每級造成4點傷害。
minor.reason: Instant Health 台灣為「瞬間治療」
minor.fix: [#](8B0000)瞬間治療[#]()靈藥不是什麼溫和的藥劑；它會向軀體注入原生的生命力，每級可瞬間恢復4點生命值。但對[#](8B0000)亡靈[#]()而言，這種生命力卻成了詛咒，每級造成4點傷害。

minor.en:
The [#](8B0000)Passive[#]() elixir extinguishes aggression from a creature's mind, rendering it docile and harmless. Even the most savage beast becomes as meek as a lamb.\
\
[#](2E8B57)This effect does not work on players; their will is too strong to be so easily quelled.[#]()
minor.tw:
[#](8B0000)溫馴[#]()靈藥能去除生物意識之中的攻擊性，讓它變得溫順無害。基本是最為暴戾的野獸也會變得溫柔如羊羔。\
\
[#](2E8B57)此效果對玩家無效，他們的意志極強，無法輕易被鎮靜。[#]()
minor.reason: 「基本是最為暴戾」語意不通，應為「即使是」
minor.fix:
[#](8B0000)溫馴[#]()靈藥能去除生物意識之中的攻擊性，讓它變得溫順無害。即使是最為暴戾的野獸也會變得溫柔如羊羔。\
\
[#](2E8B57)此效果對玩家無效，他們的意志極強，無法輕易被鎮靜。[#]()

minor.en:
The [#](8B0000)Slowness[#]() elixir thickens the blood and deadens the limbs, reducing movement speed by 15%% per level. An effective tool for hindering pursuers or fleeing prey alike.\
\
Derived from a flask of either [#](8B0000)Speed[#]() or [#](8B0000)Jump Boost[#]().
minor.tw:
[#](8B0000)緩速[#]()靈藥能讓血液變得黏稠，抽走四肢的生命力，每級可令移動速度降低15%%。它是針對追擊者和獵物的有效工具。\
\
釀造自[#](8B0000)加速[#]()靈藥或[#](8B0000)跳躍提升[#]()靈藥。
minor.reason: Speed 台灣為「迅捷」
minor.fix:
[#](8B0000)緩速[#]()靈藥能讓血液變得黏稠，抽走四肢的生命力，每級可令移動速度降低15%%。它是針對追擊者和獵物的有效工具。\
\
釀造自[#](8B0000)迅捷[#]()靈藥或[#](8B0000)跳躍提升[#]()靈藥。

minor.en: The [#](8B0000)Speed[#]() elixir quickens the drinker's stride, increasing movement speed by 20%% per level. Even a single dose transforms a cautious walk into a predator's lope.
minor.tw: [#](8B0000)加速[#]()靈藥能加快服用者的步伐，每級可令移動速度增加20%%。即便只服下一劑，也能將遲緩的步伐變得如同捕食者的追擊一般輕盈。
minor.reason: Speed 台灣為「迅捷」
minor.fix: [#](8B0000)迅捷[#]()靈藥能加快服用者的步伐，每級可令移動速度增加20%%。即便只服下一劑，也能將遲緩的步伐變得如同捕食者的追擊一般輕盈。

minor.en: The [#](8B0000)Strength[#]() elixir floods the muscles with [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#](), adding 3 points of attack damage per level. What was once an even fight becomes decidedly one-sided.
minor.tw: [#](8B0000)強力[#]()靈藥能以[#](4A0080)生命源質[#]()充盈肌肉，每級可令攻擊傷害增加3點。原本的平局現在已是一邊倒。
minor.reason: Strength 台灣為「力量」
minor.fix: [#](8B0000)力量[#]()靈藥能以[#](4A0080)生命源質[#]()充盈肌肉，每級可令攻擊傷害增加3點。原本的平局現在已是一邊倒。

minor.en:
[#](8B0000)Miner's Secrets[#]() draws forth hidden knowledge from the stone. Blocks that normally release experience yield an additional 2 points per harvest. The coating is consumed only when this bonus experience is actually extracted.\
\
Valid items: anything in [#](8B0000)#neovitae:anointable/mining[#]().\
\
Applies: Miner's Secrets (256 exp-dropping blocks)
minor.tw:
[#](8B0000)礦工之秘[#]()能從岩石之中抽取處原先隱藏著的知識。會掉落經驗的方塊額外產出2點經驗。只有真正額外抽取到經驗之時，塗層才會磨損。\
\
有效物品：所有[#](8B0000)#neovitae:anointable/mining[#]()下的物品。\
\
施加：礦工之秘（256個會掉落經驗的方塊）
minor.reason: 「抽取處」應為「抽取出」
minor.fix:

minor.en: Should your current brews prove insufficient, the answer lies in deeper materials. With [#](8B0000)Glow Berries[#](), [#](8B0000)Cobbled Deepslate[#](), and a measure of [#](8B0000)Hellforged Sand[#](), you may forge catalysts of considerably greater potency, pushing both duration and power well beyond their former limits.
minor.tw: 在現有靈藥力有不逮之時，技藝精進之路就在於地底深處的材料。使用[#](8B0000)螢光莓[#]()、[#](8B0000)深板岩碎石[#]()、一份[#](8B0000)獄鍛礦砂[#]()，即可鍛成效力大幅提升的觸媒，將原本的延時和增效效力推向新的高峰。
minor.reason: Cobbled Deepslate 台灣為「鵝卵深板岩」
minor.fix: 在現有靈藥力有不逮之時，技藝精進之路就在於地底深處的材料。使用[#](8B0000)螢光莓[#]()、[#](8B0000)鵝卵深板岩[#]()、一份[#](8B0000)獄鍛礦砂[#]()，即可鍛成效力大幅提升的觸媒，將原本的延時和增效效力推向新的高峰。

minor.en: Central to the art of flask-brewing are [#](8B0000)Catalysts[#](), reagents that shape and amplify your elixirs. Begin with these three: the [#](8B0000)Simple Catalyst[#](), the [#](8B0000)Small Power Catalyst[#](), and the [#](8B0000)Small Lengthening Catalyst[#](). The first serves as the foundation for nearly every alchemical brew, much as [#](8B0000)Nether Wart[#]() anchors lesser potions.
minor.tw: 居於藥水瓶釀造技藝之中心的，是各類[#](8B0000)觸媒[#]()——能塑造和增強靈藥的試劑。初始觸媒有三種：[#](8B0000)簡單觸媒[#]()、[#](8B0000)小型增效觸媒[#]()、[#](8B0000)小型延時觸媒[#]()。第一種是幾乎所有鍊金靈藥的基礎，和[#](8B0000)地獄疙瘩[#]()在正常藥水中的地位類似。
minor.reason: Nether Wart 台灣為「地獄疣」
minor.fix: 居於藥水瓶釀造技藝之中心的，是各類[#](8B0000)觸媒[#]()——能塑造和增強靈藥的試劑。初始觸媒有三種：[#](8B0000)簡單觸媒[#]()、[#](8B0000)小型增效觸媒[#]()、[#](8B0000)小型延時觸媒[#]()。第一種是幾乎所有鍊金靈藥的基礎，和[#](8B0000)地獄疣[#]()在正常藥水中的地位類似。

minor.en:
Potion-brewing is a pedestrian art. Any hedge-witch with a cauldron can boil nether wart into a serviceable tincture. But a [#](4A0080)Vitaemancer[#]() does not settle for serviceable.\
\
By weaving [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() into the brewing process, you transcend the crude limitations of conventional alchemy entirely.
minor.tw:
藥水釀造不算什麼高深知識，每一位綠野女巫都能在鍋釜中將地獄疙瘩煮成有實際效用的酊劑。但[#](4A0080)命血術士[#]()不會滿足於「有實際效用」。\
\
將[#](4A0080)生命源質[#]()織入釀造過程，你就將超脫於傳統鍊金術的侷限。
minor.reason: nether wart 台灣為「地獄疣」
minor.fix:
藥水釀造不算什麼高深知識，每一位綠野女巫都能在鍋釜中將地獄疣煮成有實際效用的酊劑。但[#](4A0080)命血術士[#]()不會滿足於「有實際效用」。\
\
將[#](4A0080)生命源質[#]()織入釀造過程，你就將超脫於傳統鍊金術的侷限。

minor.en: Once you have drained a flask to its dregs, simply rinse it with water to prepare a fresh vessel for your next concoction. [#](2E8B57)Consult JEI for the refilling recipe.[#]()
minor.tw: 藥水瓶在被完全耗幹後可以用水潤洗，而後就可直接用於盛裝其他藥劑。[#](2E8B57)藥水瓶補充配方請查閱JEI。[#]()
minor.reason: 「耗幹」應為「耗乾」
minor.fix: 藥水瓶在被完全耗乾後可以用水潤洗，而後就可直接用於盛裝其他藥劑。[#](2E8B57)藥水瓶補充配方請查閱JEI。[#]()

minor.en:
The [#](8B0000)Tabula Vitae[#]() is a workbench of transmutation, drawing [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() from your [#](4A0080)Anima[#]() to reshape matter itself. The [#](4A0080)Anima[#]() tapped and the [#](B8860B)tier[#]() of recipes available are governed by the [#](8B0000)Orb of Vitae[#]() socketed into its right-hand slot.\
\
Through this instrument, the Vitaemancer transmutes base materials into reagents, catalysts, and components essential to the art.
minor.tw:
[#](8B0000)命血台桌[#]()是能進行嬗變操作的工作台，會從你的[#](4A0080)本魂[#]()中抽取[#](4A0080)生命源質[#]()來重塑物質。所用[#](4A0080)本魂[#]()和可用配方[#](B8860B)層級[#]()有右側槽位中的[#](8B0000)生命寶珠[#]()決定。\
\
在這件儀器的幫助之下，命血術士可將基礎的材料嬗變為試劑、觸媒，以及對技藝來說至關重要的元件。
minor.reason: 「有…決定」應為「由…決定」
minor.fix:
[#](8B0000)命血台桌[#]()是能進行嬗變操作的工作台，會從你的[#](4A0080)本魂[#]()中抽取[#](4A0080)生命源質[#]()來重塑物質。所用[#](4A0080)本魂[#]()和可用配方[#](B8860B)層級[#]()由右側槽位中的[#](8B0000)生命寶珠[#]()決定。\

minor.en:
Even the simplest transmutations have their uses. The Tabula Vitae can produce:

- [#](8B0000)Grass Block[#]() from barren earth

- [#](8B0000)Leather[#]() purified from rotten flesh

- [#](8B0000)Bread[#]() from raw grain

- [#](8B0000)Clay[#]() drawn from sand

- [#](8B0000)String[#]() and [#](8B0000)Cobweb[#]()
minor.reason: 「基本是最簡單的」語意不通，應為「即使是」

minor.en:
Within a sixteen-block radius, [#](8B0000)passive and ambient mobs[#]() simply will not spawn. Cows, sheep, bats, fish, axolotls, and the like all find the air unwelcoming. [#](2E8B57)Hostile monsters are unaffected[#]() - the lantern wards against life, not malice.\
\
Within the [#](8B0000)Dungeon dimension[#]() the warding lies dormant; the demonic air there already smothers passive life, and the lantern would only waste cycles searching for prey that was never coming.
minor.tw:
在十六格半徑內，[#](8B0000)被動和環境生物[#]()完全不會生成。牛、綿羊、蝙蝠、各種魚、蠑螈，乃至所有類似生物都會覺得燈籠的光在驅散它們。[#](2E8B57)敵對生物不受影響[#]()——燈籠只會驅散生命，不驅散惡意。\
\
而在[#](8B0000)地城維度[#]()之中，這種驅散會進入惰性狀態；那裡的惡魔氣息已經將友善的生命摧殘殆盡了，燈籠只會因等待永遠不會到來的獵物而無謂地空轉。
minor.reason: axolotl 台灣為「六角恐龍」

minor.en: Throw one item and any number of enchanted books onto the master stone; the ritual reads the books and binds every enchantment the item can take, at whatever level the book carries, charging Essentia Vitae for each level. Two enchantments that cannot share an item halt the rite; remove one and offer the item again to resume. The books survive.
minor.tw: 在主儀式石上方丟下一件物品和任意數量的附魔書；儀式會讀取附魔書，並向物品施加它能接受的所有魔咒，等級由附魔書決定。每施加一級魔咒都需消耗生命源質。互斥魔咒會中斷儀式，取走其一再重新丟下被附魔物品可恢復。附魔書不消耗。
minor.reason: 魔咒應為附魔

minor.en: Propels non-sneaking entities in the master stone's facing direction. Sneak inside the area to receive Speed II for 30 minutes instead. Aspects modulate velocity, target filtering, and add Soft Fall.
minor.tw: 往主儀式石的朝向推動未在潛行的實體。在區域內潛行可獲得30 分鐘的加速 II。要素會調節速度、目標篩選，以及是否附加輕柔摔落。
minor.reason: Speed 藥水效果台灣譯迅捷

minor.en: Place atop a mob spawner. The next mob killed within 11x11x11 becomes the spawner's new mob, and the array is consumed.
minor.tw: 應放置在生怪磚上方。11x11x11區域內下一個被擊殺的生物會成為生怪磚的新刷取物件，同時消耗陣列。
minor.reason: 「刷取物件」為大陸生硬用語
minor.fix: 應放置在生怪磚上方。11x11x11區域內下一個被擊殺的生物會成為生怪磚的新生物，同時消耗陣列。

minor.en: Sentient multitool: chops, mines, digs, tills. Sneak-right-click to toggle. Sneak+scroll to set mining radius. The Cycle Mode key switches the beam between mining, damage, and both. Mined blocks are sent straight to your inventory.
minor.tw: 多功能感知工具：砍伐、開採、挖掘、開墾均可。潛行右擊以切換。潛行滾動滾輪以設定挖掘半徑。迴圈模式鍵可在僅挖掘、僅攻擊、兩者均可間切換能束功能。挖下的方塊會直接進入你的物品欄。
minor.reason: 迴圈模式為大陸程式用語，應為循環
minor.fix: 多功能感知工具：砍伐、開採、挖掘、開墾均可。潛行右擊以切換。潛行滾動滾輪以設定挖掘半徑。循環模式鍵可在僅挖掘、僅攻擊、兩者均可間切換能束功能。挖下的方塊會直接進入你的物品欄。

minor.en:
If you want to save your miners before they break, check "Server Configuration > Items".
 By setting the "Save miners before breaking" option to "on", a miner will go to the output
 of the dimensional mineshaft when it reaches 1 durability. The effects of enchantments can also be turned off.
minor.tw:
若想避免礦工損壞，前往「服務端設定 > 物品」介面進行設定。
將「損壞前輸出礦工」選項設為「開」後，當礦工的耐久度降至1時，其將被自動傳輸至維度礦井的輸出位置。魔咒的效果也可以被關閉。
minor.reason: 服務端、魔咒為大陸用語
minor.fix:
若想避免礦工損壞，前往「伺服器端設定 > 物品」介面進行設定。
將「損壞前輸出礦工」選項設為「開」後，當礦工的耐久度降至1時，其將被自動傳輸至維度礦井的輸出位置。附魔的效果也可以被關閉。

minor.en:
You've noticed that your miner can be enchanted? Here's how effective it is!\
 **Efficiency:** Increase the progress bar by the smaller of two RNB;\
 **Fortune:** Mine a number of extra results equals smaller of three RNB;\
 **Silk touch:** Multiply the count of mined result by 1 plus a RNB;\
 RNB = random number between 0 and the enchantment level.
minor.tw:
你有沒有注意到礦工能夠被附魔？來看看它的效果！\
 **效率**：增加進度條，增加值取兩個隨機數中較小值；\
 **幸運**：額外挖掘次數取三個隨機數中最小值；\
 **絲綢之觸**：挖掘數量乘以(1+隨機數)；\
 隨機數範圍：0至附魔等級。
minor.reason: 魔咒應為附魔
minor.fix:

minor.en:
The **Unbreaking** and **Mending** enchantments function as vanilla.
\
 With other methods (mods) you can make your miner unusable (**unusing**)
 when it's close to breaking, or even truly unbreakable (**eternal**).
minor.tw:
**耐久**和**修補**魔咒的工作機制和原版一樣。
\
搭配其他思路（模組），能夠讓礦工在快要損壞時無法被使用（**保險**魔咒），
甚至實現真正意義上的不毀（**永恆**魔咒）。
minor.reason: 魔咒應為附魔；「其他思路」生硬
minor.fix:
**耐久**和**修補**附魔的工作機制和原版一樣。
\

甚至實現真正意義上的不毀（**永恆**附魔）。

[](item://occultism:iesnium_anvil)是一件[#](AA00AA)魔王[#]()灌注物品。
該砧具有以下改進特性：
1. 不會損壞；
2. 可使魔咒等級上限+1；
3. 魔王將支付所顯示經驗等花費的一半（上取整）；
4. 同一物品重複操作導致的消耗增幅將降低；
5. 最高消耗上限提升；

minor.en:
The [#](AA00AA)Djinni[#]() miner harvests most general ores. It is able to mine faster and more efficiently.
 The greater power of the djinni it damages the magic lamp relatively quickly.
minor.tw:
[#](AA00AA)巨靈[#]()礦工能夠採集絕大部分常規礦物。它的挖掘速度更快，效率更高。
然而巨靈的強大強力也讓神燈損壞得更快。
minor.reason: 「強大強力」贅詞不自然
minor.fix:
[#](AA00AA)巨靈[#]()礦工能夠採集絕大部分常規礦物。它的挖掘速度更快，效率更高。
然而巨靈的強大力量也讓神燈損壞得更快。

minor.en:
Soul gems are diamonds set in precious metals, which are then infused with a [#](AA00AA)Djinni[#]().
 The spirit creates a small dimension that allows the temporary entrapment of living beings.
 Beings of great power or size cannot be stored, however.
minor.tw:
靈魂寶石是以珍貴金屬作為嵌座，並注入有[#](AA00AA)巨靈[#]()的鑽石。
巨靈會創造一個小空間，暫時困住生物。
但無法儲存強力強大或者體型巨大的存在。
minor.reason: 「強力強大」贅詞不自然

靈魂寶石是以珍貴金屬作為嵌座，並注入有[#](AA00AA)巨靈[#]()的鑽石。

但無法儲存力量強大或者體型巨大的存在。

minor.en:
Summoning a spirit into the lenses used to craft goggles is one of the
 first of the more complex rituals apprentice summoners usually attempt,
 showing that their skills are progressing beyond the basics.
minor.tw:
將魔靈灌注到鏡片中製作眼鏡，
常常是新手召喚師所嘗試的第一個複雜儀式之一。
這個儀式證明他們的掌握的技能已經不僅限於基礎知識。

minor.en:
Occultism offers two storage solutions: the first is based on satchels, portable inventories with different functions depending on the type.
 Some are already obtainable, while others will require evolve in the mod first.
minor.tw:
神秘學提供了兩種儲存方案：第一種基於挎包，這是一種便攜儲存空間，其功能依種類而異。
其中一部分目前即可獲得，而其他的則需要先在推進本模組進度。
minor.reason: 「需要先在推進本模組進度」文句不通；便攜為大陸用語
minor.fix:
神秘學提供了兩種儲存方案：第一種基於挎包，這是一種可攜式儲存空間，其功能依種類而異。
其中一部分目前即可獲得，而其他的則需要先推進本模組的進度。

minor.en:
Ritual recipe pages, such as the previous pageshow not only the ingredients, but also the pentacle that you need to draw with chalk in order to use the ritual.
\
\
**To show the pentacle, click the blue link** at the center top of the ritual page. You can then even preview it in-world.
minor.tw:
像之前展示的儀式配方頁面一樣，這些頁面不止顯示原材料，也會顯示需要你需要用粉筆畫出來以進行儀式的五芒星陣。
\
\
在儀式頁面**點選上方中間的藍色連結顯示五芒星陣**，你甚至可以在世界中預覽。
minor.reason: 「需要你需要」重複、語句不通順
minor.fix:
像之前展示的儀式配方頁面一樣，這些頁面不只顯示材料，也會顯示使用儀式時需要用粉筆畫出來的五芒星陣。
\
\
在儀式頁面**點選上方中間的藍色連結顯示五芒星陣**，你甚至可以在世界中預覽。

minor.en:
You can place another [](item://occultism:golden_sacrificial_bowl) in the third block below the
 original [](item://occultism:golden_sacrificial_bowl). Every time this new bowl receives an
 block update, it clones the actual signal strength of the original bowl.
minor.tw: 可在原來的[](item://occultism:golden_sacrificial_bowl)下方第三格放置另一個[](item://occultism:golden_sacrificial_bowl)。每次這個新的儀式之碗接收到方塊更新時，其便會克隆原始碗的實際訊號強度。
minor.reason: 「克隆」為大陸用語
minor.fix: 可在原來的[](item://occultism:golden_sacrificial_bowl)下方第三格放置另一個[](item://occultism:golden_sacrificial_bowl)。每次這個新的儀式之碗接收到方塊更新時，其便會複製原始碗的實際訊號強度。

minor.en: An easier way to clone any dye, mix this flower and the target color. You can also make ~~suspicious~~ delicious stews.
minor.tw: 一種更簡單的染料克隆方法：將這朵花與目標顏色混合即可。你還能用它製作~~謎之~~美味燉菜。
minor.reason: 「克隆」為大陸用語
minor.fix: 一種更簡單的染料複製方法：將這朵花與目標顏色混合即可。你還能用它製作~~謎之~~美味燉菜。

minor.en:
This is a rare metal that, to the naked eye, looks like [](item://minecraft:netherrack) and cannot be mined with a regular pickaxe.
\
\
When mined with the correct tools, it can be used to craft powerful items (you will learn more about that later).
minor.tw:
這種稀有金屬肉眼看起來就像[](item://minecraft:netherrack)一般，也無法使用常規的鎬子開採。
\
\
用合適的工具開採後，它可以用來製作強力的物品（稍後會進行講解）。
minor.reason: Netherrack 台灣官方為地獄岩
minor.fix:
這種稀有金屬肉眼看起來就像[](item://minecraft:netherrack)一般，也無法使用常規的鎬子開採。
\
\
用合適的工具開採後，它可以用來製作強力的物品（稍後會進行講解）。

minor.en:
Like Netherrack, Iesnium can be found in the Nether. In order to **see** it, you need to wear [Otherworld Goggles](entry://occultism:dictionary_of_spirits/getting_started/otherworld_goggles).
\
\
To make searching for it simpler, attune a [Divination Rod](entry://occultism:dictionary_of_spirits/getting_started/divination_rod) to it and righ-click and hold in the nether until it highlights a nearby block, which will hold the ore.
minor.tw:
如同地獄石一樣，艾瑟金屬生成在地獄。為了**看到**它，你需要穿戴[異界眼鏡](entry://occultism:dictionary_of_spirits/getting_started/otherworld_goggles)。
\
\
為了更方便的找到艾瑟金屬，你可以將其與[偵測杖](entry://occultism:dictionary_of_spirits/getting_started/divination_rod)同調並在地獄長按右鍵，直到它高亮附近的艾瑟金屬礦石。
minor.reason: 地獄石應為地獄岩；「高亮」為大陸用語
minor.fix:
如同地獄岩一樣，艾瑟金屬生成在地獄。為了**看到**它，你需要穿戴[異界眼鏡](entry://occultism:dictionary_of_spirits/getting_started/otherworld_goggles)。
\
\
為了更方便的找到艾瑟金屬，你可以將其與[偵測杖](entry://occultism:dictionary_of_spirits/getting_started/divination_rod)同調並在地獄長按右鍵，直到它標示出附近的艾瑟金屬礦石。

minor.en: Otherstone and otherrock are primarily obtained through dimensional mining using miner spirits in the Dimensional Mineshaft. They can also be produced by Crusher and Smelter spirits from stone and netherrack.
minor.tw: 異界石和異界岩主要透過維度礦井中的礦工魔靈進行維度挖掘獲得。也可以透過碎礦者魔靈和熔鍊者魔靈透過石頭和地獄石產出。
minor.reason: 地獄石應為地獄岩；「透過」連用生硬
minor.fix: 異界石和異界岩主要透過維度礦井中的礦工魔靈進行維度挖掘獲得。也可以由碎礦者魔靈和熔鍊者魔靈將石頭和地獄岩加工產出。

minor.en: This block acts as a portal, for spirits only, to the [#](ad03fc)Mining Dimension[#](). Place a Magic Lamp with a Miner Spirit in it, to make it mine for you.
minor.tw: 這個方塊就像一個僅供魔靈使用的傳送門，通往[#](ad03fc)採礦維度[#]()。在裡面放一個帶有采礦魔靈的神燈，可讓它為你採礦。
minor.reason: 「采礦」轉換殘留簡體字
minor.fix: 這個方塊就像一個僅供魔靈使用的傳送門，通往[#](ad03fc)採礦維度[#]()。在裡面放一個帶有採礦魔靈的神燈，可讓它為你採礦。

minor.en: Cursed honey is dropped by Possessed Bees. Eating it grants instant health and absorption effects.
minor.tw: 詛咒蜂蜜由被附身的蜜蜂掉落。食用後獲得立即治療和吸收效果。
minor.reason: Instant Health 台灣為瞬間治療

minor.en:
Ritual satchels are bags that can hold items needed to create pentacles for rituals.\
More importantly, they can automatically place the right items for a pentacle, removing the need to manually place chalks, candles, crystals, skulls and other items needed for rituals.\\
The Apprentice Satchel places pentacle blocks one by one.\
The improved Artisanal Satchel places all pentacle blocks in a single action.\
minor.tw:
儀式挎包是專用於收納五芒星陣佈置物品的容器。\
其核心功能在於自動擺放星陣所需物品，免除手動佈置粉筆、蠟燭、水晶、頭顱等儀式物品的繁瑣。\
學徒挎包可以逐個擺放五芒星陣方塊。\
改進的匠心挎包則可以一次性佈置整個五芒星陣。

minor.en:
Lamps are commonly used to access a [#](ad03fc)Mining Dimension[#]() and act as (*lag free*) [#](ad03fc)Void Miners[#]().
 This is a great way to get resources without having to go mining in the overworld (or other dimesions) yourself.

這是可以不親自在主世界（或其他維度）挖礦就能獲得資源的一個好辦法。

minor.en:
**Purpose:** Bind [#](AA00AA)Afrit[#]()\
\
First discovered by Grandmistress Sevira of Emberwoods, **Seviras Permanent Confinement** is used for
 binding [#](AA00AA)Afrit[#]() into objects. Due to the power of the spirits involved, this should be performed only by advanced summoners.
minor.tw:
**目的**：束縛[#](AA00AA)火靈[#]()\
\
由灰燼林地的召喚宗師塞維拉首次發現的**塞維拉永囚咒**，主要用於將[#](AA00AA)火靈[#]()束縛於物體之中。由於涉及到的魔靈強力強大，此術僅應由高階召喚師施展。

minor.en:
In this type of ritual, a [#](ad03fc)Spirit[#]() is summoned **as an untamed creature** to take the shape of a random animal.
Different rituals can be performed, each with their own respective animals, check in the ritual dummy or in the recipe output the possibilities.
\
The animal can be interacted with as its natural counterpart, including taming, breeding and loot.
minor.tw:
在這個儀式中，一隻[#](ad03fc)魔靈[#]()將會以**未馴服的生物**的形態隨機化形成某種隨機動物。
不同儀式可召喚的動物種類各異，具體可能性請檢視儀式象徵物或配方產出說明。\
\
該動物可像其自然存在的同類一樣進行互動，包括馴服、繁殖及獲取戰利品。

Some rituals require the use of certain items to be performed. Use the item described on the ritual's page within **16 blocks** of the [](item://occultism:golden_sacrificial_bowl) to proceed with the ritual.
\
\
**Important:** Before using the item, start the ritual. Grey particles indicate that the ritual is ready for the item use.

\
\
**重要**：在使用物品之前，先啟動儀式。灰色粒子密度代表已經可以在儀式上使用物品了。

minor.en: If a ritual shows grey particles above the golden ritual bowl, then additional requirements as described in the ritual's page need to be fulfilled. Once all requirements are fulfilled, the ritual will show purple particles and start to consume the items in the sacrificial bowls.
minor.tw: 如果在黃金儀式之碗的上方顯示灰色粒子，那就代表仍需要完成一些儀式頁面上所述的額外要求。一旦所有要求都已滿足，儀式會顯示紫色的粒子密度，然後開始消耗獻祭之碗中的物品。

minor.en: Rituals allow to summon spirits into our plane of existence, or bind them into objects or living beings. Every ritual consists of a [#](ad03fc)Pentacle[#](), [#](ad03fc)Ritual Ingredients[#]() provided via sacrificial bowls, a [#](ad03fc)Starting Item[#]() and optionally the [#](ad03fc)Sacrifice[#]() of living beings. A purple particle effect will show that the ritual is successful and in progress.
minor.tw: 儀式能將魔靈召喚進我們的存在位面，或者將其束縛進物體或生物之中。每個儀式的組成都有以下幾部分：一個[#](ad03fc)五芒星陣[#]()、透過獻祭之碗提供的[#](ad03fc)材料[#]()、一個[#](ad03fc)啟動物品[#]()，以及部分儀式才需要的生物[#](ad03fc)祭品[#]()。如果儀式啟動成功並正在運作，則會出現紫色粒子密度。
minor.reason: 「紫色粒子密度」為誤譯，原文是紫色粒子效果。
minor.fix: 儀式能將魔靈召喚進我們的存在位面，或者將其束縛進物體或生物之中。每個儀式的組成都有以下幾部分：一個[#](ad03fc)五芒星陣[#]()、透過獻祭之碗提供的[#](ad03fc)材料[#]()、一個[#](ad03fc)啟動物品[#]()，以及部分儀式才需要的生物[#](ad03fc)祭品[#]()。如果儀式啟動成功並正在運作，則會出現紫色粒子效果。

minor.en:
Crusher spirits are summoned to crush ores into dusts, effectively multiplying the metal output.
   They will pick up appropriate ores and drop the resulting dusts into the world.
   A spark particle effect and a crushing sound indicate the crusher is at work.
minor.tw:
碎礦者是一種召喚出來的魔靈，它能夠將礦石粉碎為粉末，相當於使金屬產量翻倍。
它們會拾取合適的物品，並將粉碎後的產物丟在世界中。
火花粒子密度與碾碎音效的顯現，表明碎礦者正在工作。
minor.reason: 「火花粒子密度」為誤譯，原文是 spark particle effect。
minor.fix:
碎礦者是一種召喚出來的魔靈，它能夠將礦石粉碎為粉末，相當於使金屬產量翻倍。
它們會拾取合適的物品，並將粉碎後的產物丟在世界中。
火花粒子效果與碾碎音效的顯現，表明碎礦者正在工作。

minor.en:
Crystallizer spirits are summoned to regenerate gem from their dusts and directly multiply
the output of breaking gem ores. They will pick up appropriate items and drop the resulting into
the world. A magical particle effect and a amethyst sound indicate the crystallizer is at work.
minor.tw:
鑄晶者魔靈可從粉末中再生寶石，並能直接提升寶石礦物的產量。
它們會拾取合適的物品，並將轉化後的產物丟在世界中。
魔法粒子密度與紫水晶音效的顯現，表明鑄晶者正在工作。
minor.reason: 「魔法粒子密度」為誤譯，原文是 magical particle effect。

魔法粒子效果與紫水晶音效的顯現，表明鑄晶者正在工作。

minor.en: Only trader, time and weather spirits are affected by essence decay, by default. All others are immune and will not despawn. Modpacks may modify this behaviour.
minor.tw: 預設情況下，只有交易者、時間和天氣魔靈會受到靈髓衰退的影響。其他種類的魔靈均免疫此效果，不會消失。整合包可能會修改這一設定。
minor.reason: 「整合包」為大陸用語，台灣用「模組包」。

minor.en:
Once again, item extraction is the critical issue for performance.
\
\
To make use of the performance optimization, use a [](item://theurgy:logistics_item_extractor)
 and apply a [](item://theurgy:list_filter) to extract the desired items.
\
\
The Theurgy Guidebook "The Hermetica" has a chapter on Theurgy
 mercurial logistics and how to use them to insert and extract items.
minor.tw:
再強調一次，物品提取是影響效能的關鍵因素。
\
\
為了效能最佳化，請使用[](item://theurgy:logistics_item_extractor)，
並搭配[](item://theurgy:list_filter)來提取所需物品。
\
\

minor.en: Obtain a laser arm block. Power up, mine fluxite, and dig through the earth. Pew pew, you're unstoppable
minor.tw: 獲得一個鐳射臂方塊。啟動機器，採集輻水晶，然後挖穿地球。寶貝，你勢不可擋！
minor.reason: 鐳射為大陸用語；Pew pew 被誤譯成「寶貝」

minor.en: Applicable to Enderic Laser. Used to target living entities. Range increases with each addon.
minor.tw: 適用於終界鐳射器，用於瞄準生物。每附加外掛會擴大其生效範圍。

minor.en: Warning: Tinkering with the arcane can have dangerous consequences. Stabilize it with an enderic laser.

minor.en:
Harvests crops in a range (from 3x3 to 9x9 blocks) around the pylon and outputs to an inventory above.
Place the pylon inside the water block of the farm, or level with the crops.

By default (configurable) this will require a hoe in the pylon, and use 1 durability per harvest,
unless the hoe is unbreakable. Unbreaking and other durability enchants are supported.

Optionally can be configured to require power instead of durability.

Can be toggled automatically with redstone.
minor.tw:
收穫周圍半徑（3x3到9x9格）內的作物，並輸出到其上方的容器中。
將塔放置在農田的水源方塊中，或與作物處於同一高度。

預設情況下（可配置），塔中需要放置一把鋤，每次收穫消耗1點耐久，
除非其是無法損壞的。支援耐久以及其他耐久度相關魔咒。

可選擇配置為需要能量而不是耐久度。

可透過紅石訊號自動切換開關狀態。
minor.reason: 魔咒為大陸用語，台灣用附魔

minor.en: Craft a Portable Grid to access the content of disks without requiring a storage network
minor.tw: 合成一個便攜終端，在不連線至儲存網路時訪問磁碟內容
minor.reason: 便攜、訪問為大陸用語
minor.fix: 合成一個可攜式終端，在不連線至儲存網路時存取磁碟內容

minor.tw: 此器件是否應將能量緩衝器從輸入網路傳遞到輸出網路。

minor.en: Connects storage network devices with each other. For full blocks, will connect to any color. For cable blocks, will only connect to the same color or to the default color (gray).
minor.tw: 連線儲存網路裝置。對於完整的塊，將連線到任何顏色。對於線纜，將僅連線到相同顏色或預設顏色（灰色）

minor.en: The maximum amount of rows that can be displayed when the screen size is stretched.
minor.tw: 畫面最大可現實的行數
minor.reason: 「現實」應為「顯示」，且漏譯畫面被拉伸的條件
minor.fix: 當畫面大小被拉伸時，最多可顯示的行數。

minor.en:
Craft certain items and blocks with the tome to duplicate them.
You can right-click Altars of Light to fuel them with redstone from the tome.
minor.tw:
你可以使用萬能溶劑之經來複制某些物品或者方塊。
你也可以對著光明祭壇右鍵來為祭壇注入來自書中的紅石。
minor.reason: 「複制」應為「複製」
minor.fix:
你可以使用萬能溶劑之經來複製某些物品或方塊。
你也可以對著光明祭壇右鍵來為祭壇注入來自書中的紅石。

minor.en: Dispels blaze fireballs and reflects ghast fireballs while held. Puts out fires on and around you.
minor.tw: 手持時可驅散烈焰使者和地獄幽靈發射的火球，並且會熄滅你身上的著火效果和附近的火焰。

minor.en: Potion essences together with nether wart are made into potions in this cauldron. You will need a lit fire underneath  and water inside to start and empty potion vials to get the potion out of the cauldron.
minor.tw: 可在藥師坩堝中使用藥水精華和地獄疙瘩來釀造藥水，你需要在藥師坩堝底部點火併且在坩堝內部放水才可以讓藥師坩堝工作，釀造完成後手持濃縮藥水瓶對著藥師坩堝右鍵來取出釀造的藥水。
minor.reason: 「點火併且」轉換錯字，應為「並且」
minor.fix: 可在藥師坩堝中使用藥水精華和地獄疙瘩來釀造藥水，你需要在藥師坩堝底部點火並且在坩堝內部放水才可以讓藥師坩堝工作，釀造完成後手持濃縮藥水瓶對著藥師坩堝右鍵來取出釀造的藥水。

minor.en: Sand shots cause blindness (useful in PVP), also cause creepers to explode instantly, they are weakened in rain.
minor.tw: 揚沙彈會使目標緻盲，在PVP中效果明顯，命中苦力怕時會導致其瞬間爆炸，在雨天使用揚沙彈會降低攻擊效果。
minor.reason: 「緻盲」應為「致盲」
minor.fix: 揚沙彈會使目標致盲，在PVP中效果明顯，命中苦力怕時會導致其瞬間爆炸，在雨天使用揚沙彈會降低攻擊效果。

minor.en: An example setup for a Reformation Array. Note that other placements are possible.
minor.tw: 重塑陣列的靈感結構。其他的擺放形式也可行。

minor.fix: 重塑陣列的範例結構。其他的擺放形式也可行。

minor.en:
Reformation requires a target sulfur that the source will be transformed into, effectively replicating the target.
\
This type of pedestal holds these target sulfurs that **will not be consumed in the process** and in fact will be multiplied.
minor.tw:
重塑需要目標硫作為源材硫的轉換產物，相當於複製目標硫。
\
這種台座用於盛裝目標硫，過程中它們**不會被銷燬**，而是會被複制。
minor.reason: 「複制」應為「複製」。

\

minor.en: The rod will indicate that it found a block by *changing color* to be partially or fully purple, and by emitting a *glowing ball* that will fly towards the block, when right-clicked without holding.
minor.tw: 找到方塊的偵測杖的整體或部分會*變成*紫色，併發出一個飛向該方塊的*熒光球體*，右鍵單擊時也會發射這種球體。
minor.reason: 「併發出」應為「並發出」；「熒光」台灣用「螢光」。
minor.fix: 找到方塊的偵測杖的整體或部分會*變成*紫色，並發出一個飛向該方塊的*螢光球體*，右鍵單擊時也會發射這種球體。

minor.en: A rod pre-attuned to abundant ores, such as [copper](item://minecraft:copper_ore) or [coal](item://minecraft:coal_ore).
minor.tw: 預先與丰度高的礦石同調的偵測杖，此類礦石包括[銅](item://minecraft:copper_ore)和[煤炭](item://minecraft:coal_ore)。
minor.reason: 「丰度」應為「豐度」。

minor.en:
Right-click a block that has a fluid tank to attach the inserter to it.
\
\
The inserter will by default insert into the face it is attached to. This only matters if the block has multiple fluid tanks accessible from different block faces.
minor.tw:
右擊可儲存流體的方塊以在其上放置輸入器。
\
\
輸入器預設會向附著的一側存入。僅在方塊有多個流體儲罐，且各儲罐可透過不同側面訪問時需著重考慮這一特性。

minor.en:
Spagyrics show that matter and energy are closely related, interchangeable even.
\
\
Mercury is the energetic aspect of matter, which can be moved both in crystal form and as energy, over metal wires.
minor.tw:
萃煉是物質與能量間緊密聯絡的寫照，甚至展現了兩者互換的可能。
\
\
鍊金汞是物質的能量，可以用晶體形態運輸，也可透過能量形態在金屬線纜上轉移。
minor.reason: 「聯絡」為「聯繫」轉換誤字
minor.fix:
萃煉顯示物質與能量關係緊密，甚至可以互換。
\
\
鍊金汞是物質的能量面向，可以用晶體形態運輸，也可透過能量形態在金屬線纜上轉移。

minor.en:
With this mode, right-clicking on a block will cycle the selected direction of the target block.
\
\
The "selected direction" is the direction the block will insert/extract to/from.
\
\
The default selected direction is the face the block is attached to.
minor.tw:
在此模式下，右擊方塊會迴圈切換目標方塊的選定方向。
\
\
「選定方向」，即方塊接受輸入輸出的方向。
\
\
預設的選定方向是方塊附著的那一面。
minor.reason: 「迴圈」為 cycle 的轉換誤譯，應為循環
minor.fix:

\
\

\

minor.en: Render transmogs in world, inventories and the hotbar. Items will look like the item they're transmogrified as even in your inventory (Hidden items will still show up as the original item in the inventory). This might get confusing!
minor.tw: 同時顯示世界和揹包，物品在你的揹包裡會變化成你所選擇的物品（隱藏的物品依然會在揹包中顯示為未幻化的物品）
minor.reason: 漏掉「可能造成混淆」的警告，且敘述生硬
minor.fix: 在世界、背包和快捷欄中都顯示幻化。物品在背包中也會呈現為所幻化成的外觀（隱藏的物品在背包中仍會顯示為原物品）。這可能會造成混淆！

minor.en: List of dimensions that wild waystones are not allowed to spawn in, even if the biome is in the `has_structure/waystone` tag. Only used if wildWaystonesDimensionAllowList is empty.
minor.tw: 不允許野生傳送石碑生成的維度清單。僅在 野生傳送石碑緯度生成白名單 為空時生效
minor.reason: 「緯度」應為「維度」，且漏掉生態域標籤條件

minor.en: Set to REGULAR to have waystones spawn in some villages. Set to FREQUENT to have waystones spawn in most villages. Set to DISABLED to disable waystone generation in villages. Waystones will only spawn in vanilla or supported villages.
minor.tw: 設定為 REGULAR 時就會生成在某些村莊，設為 FREQUENT 時大多數村莊都會生成，設定為 DISABLED 時禁止生成。傳送石碑只會在村莊或允許的村莊中生成
minor.reason: 漏掉「原版（vanilla）」村莊的限定
minor.fix: 設定為 REGULAR 時，傳送石碑會生成在部分村莊；設為 FREQUENT 時，大多數村莊都會生成；設定為 DISABLED 時，村莊中不會生成傳送石碑。傳送石碑只會在原版或受支援的村莊中生成

minor.en: In Theurgy, Water Buckets can be obtained by inserting Crystallized Water into a Sal Ammoniac Accumulator placed on top of a Sal Ammoniac Tank. The tank fills with Water slowly, which can then be extracted by clicking it with an Empty Bucket.
minor.tw: 在神通術中，向硇砂儲罐上方的硇砂蓄積器中放入晶化水可獲得水桶。儲罐會緩速積累水，而後可用空鐵桶點選取出。
minor.reason: Empty Bucket 譯為「空鐵桶」多出「鐵」，官方為空桶
minor.fix: 在神通術中，向硇砂儲罐上方的硇砂蓄積器中放入晶化水可獲得水桶。儲罐會緩速積累水，而後可用空桶點選取出。

minor.en: In Theurgy, Sal Ammoniac Buckets can be obtained by inserting either just Water or Water and Sal Ammoniac Crystals into a Sal Ammoniac Accumulator placed on top of a Sal Ammoniac Tank. The tank fills with Sal Ammoniac slowly, which can then be extracted by clicking it with an Empty Bucket.
minor.tw: 在神通術中，向硇砂儲罐上方的硇砂蓄積器中放入水，或額外放入硇砂晶體可獲得硇砂桶。儲罐會緩速積累硇砂，而後可用空鐵桶點選取出。

minor.en: In Theurgy, Lava Buckets can be obtained by inserting Crystallized Lava into a Sal Ammoniac Accumulator placed on top of a Sal Ammoniac Tank. The tank fills with Lava slowly, which can then be extracted by clicking it with an Empty Bucket.
minor.tw: 在神通術中，向硇砂儲罐上方的硇砂蓄積器中放入晶化熔岩可獲得熔岩桶。儲罐會緩速積累熔岩，而後可用空鐵桶點選取出。

minor.fix: 在神通術中，向硇砂儲罐上方的硇砂蓄積器中放入晶化熔岩可獲得熔岩桶。儲罐會緩速積累熔岩，而後可用空桶點選取出。

minor.tw: 空手右擊紅石鍾方塊可調整脈衝頻率，潛行可加快調節速度

minor.en: When combined with $(9)Aqua Affinity$(), you can have full break speed when swimming.
minor.tw: 當與$(9)親水性$()結合時，你可以在游泳時擁有和陸地上一樣的破壞速度。

minor.tw: 要達到75級，你需要升級你的深暗書櫃。$(p)這樣做需要只能在$(9)深暗領域$()找到的材料。$(p)$(9)回聲碎片$()可以從遠古城市戰利品儲物箱獲得，$(9)伏聆$()可以透過絲綢之觸收集。
minor.reason: Ancient City 台灣官方為古城
minor.fix: 要達到75級，你需要升級你的深暗書櫃。$(p)這樣做需要只能在$(9)深暗領域$()找到的材料。$(p)$(9)回聲碎片$()可以從古城的戰利品儲物箱獲得，$(9)伏聆$()可以透過絲綢之觸收集。

minor.en: The highest level an Enchanting Table can reach is Level 100, but only one shelf can provide this much power.$(p)Creating such a shelf requires venturing into the outer end to retrieve a $(9)Dragon Head$().
minor.tw: 附魔台的最高等級為100級，但只有一種書櫃可以提供如此強大的強力。$(p)合成這種書櫃需要冒險進入終界外島拿到$(9)龍首$()。
minor.reason: 『強大的強力』生硬重複
minor.fix: 附魔台的最高等級為100級，但只有一種書櫃可以提供如此強大的威力。$(p)合成這種書櫃需要冒險進入終界外島拿到$(9)龍首$()。

minor.en: By default, the rarities have the following weights:$(p)Common: 10$(br)Uncommon: 5$(br)Rare: 3$(br)Very Rare: 1$(p)Every 10% of $(arcana) changes the weights, eventually becoming fully inverted.$(p)Hovering the $(arcana) Bar will show the current weights.
minor.tw: 預設情況下，稀有度的權重如下：$(p)正常：10$(br)罕見：5$(br)稀有：3$(br)非常稀有：1$(p)每增加10%的$(#A800A8)阿卡那$()就會改變權重，最終，稀有度順序會完全反轉。$(p)懸停在$(#A800A8)阿卡那$()條上會顯示目前權重。
minor.reason: Common 稀有度譯成『正常』，應為普通
minor.fix: 預設情況下，稀有度的權重如下：$(p)普通：10$(br)罕見：5$(br)稀有：3$(br)非常稀有：1$(p)每增加10%的$(#A800A8)阿卡那$()就會改變權重，最終，稀有度順序會完全反轉。$(p)懸停在$(#A800A8)阿卡那$()條上會顯示目前權重。

minor.en: First, we'll go over how enchantments are selected.$(p)Each enchantment has a $(5)Power Function$(), which controls what $(fpower) will make a specific level available.$(p)Once all the available enchantments are gathered, some are selected randomly based on their weights.
minor.tw: 首先，我們來看看如何選擇魔咒。$(p)每個魔咒都有一個$(5)附魔威力函式$()，它控制著需要多少$(#CC00CC)最終附魔威力$(),才能使一個特定的附魔等級可用。$(p)一旦所有可用的魔咒都被程式收集，系統會根據其權重隨機選擇其中一些魔咒進行附魔。
minor.reason: gathered 被譯成『被程式收集』，多出程式一詞；逗號為半形
minor.fix: 首先，我們來看看如何選擇魔咒。$(p)每個魔咒都有一個$(5)附魔威力函式$()，它控制著需要多少$(#CC00CC)最終附魔威力$()，才能使一個特定的附魔等級可用。$(p)一旦所有可用的魔咒都被收集起來，就會根據其權重隨機選擇其中一些。

minor.en: Note: books can be inserted the same way you use a chiseled bookshelf, and the shelf must be in a valid bookshelf slot to operate.$(p)Blacklisted enchantments will be reflected in the $(l:apotheosis:enchanting/table/info)Enchanting Info Screen$().
minor.tw: 注意：放入附魔書的方式與使用浮雕書櫃的方式相同，書櫃必須位於有效的書櫃槽位中才能操作。$(p)被列入黑名單的魔咒將在$(l:apotheosis:enchanting/table/info)附魔資訊介面$()顯示。

minor.en: The Tome of Scrapping is a way of retrieving enchantments from an item.$(p)Combining one with another item in an anvil will destroy the other item, and make a book with some of the enchantments at random.
minor.tw: 拆解寶典是一種從物品中獲取魔咒的方法。$(p)在鐵砧中把它和另一件物品結合起來，會銷燬另一件物品，並隨機製造出一本帶有一些魔咒的書。
minor.reason: 銷燬應為銷毀
minor.fix: 拆解寶典是一種從物品中獲取魔咒的方法。$(p)在鐵砧中把它和另一件物品結合起來，會銷毀另一件物品，並隨機製造出一本帶有一些魔咒的書。

minor.en: The $(9)Tome of Extraction$() is a perfected version of the Tome of Scrapping.$(p)It extracts all the enchantments from an item, and does not destroy the item in the process.
minor.tw: $(9)提取寶典$()是拆解寶典的完美版本。$(p)它會提取物品上的所有魔咒，並且在此過程中不會銷燬該物品。
minor.reason: 銷燬應為銷毀
minor.fix: $(9)提取寶典$()是拆解寶典的完美版本。$(p)它會提取物品上的所有魔咒，並且在此過程中不會銷毀該物品。

minor.en: The infusion recipe for Unbreakable charms is rather difficult.$(p)You'll need a firm understanding of $(l:apotheosis:enchanting/table/stats)Enchanting Stats$() to be able to complete it.
minor.tw: 不毀護符的灌注配方相當困難。$(p)你需要充分理解$(l:apotheosis:enchanting/table/stats)附魔狀態$()才能完成它。

minor.en: Its possible to make fine tuned adjustments to the copy area by opening the Adjust Placement window in the settings menu.$(br2)From here, you can adjust the position of the start block and end block. Click the plus and minus buttons to see the green box change in real time.$(br2)You can also swap to 'absolute' coordinates mode and enter in-game world coordinates instead.
minor.tw: 開啟設定選單中的「配置」視窗，可以對複製區域進行微調。$(br2)        在這裡可以調整起始方塊和結束方塊的座標，左鍵單擊加號或減號按鈕可以實時檢視綠色輪廓的變化。$(br2)        您還可以切換至絕對座標模式並輸入世界座標。
minor.reason: 實時為大陸用語，台灣用即時
minor.fix: 開啟設定選單中的「配置」視窗，可以對複製區域進行微調。$(br2)在這裡可以調整起始方塊和結束方塊的座標，左鍵單擊加號或減號按鈕可以即時檢視綠色輪廓的變化。$(br2)您還可以切換至絕對座標模式並輸入世界座標。

minor.en: Destruction Gadget
minor.tw: 調整範圍
